description.en: Generated from the awesome-dsh-plugin catalog (5704 entries): npm bundles whose manifest declares dsh.bundle. Inclusion is not a security review.
description.zh: 由 awesome-dsh-plugin 目录（5704 条）生成：只收录 manifest 声明了 dsh.bundle 的 npm 组合包。收录不代表安全审查。

title.zh: WSL 与 Windows 互操作

description.en: Open plugin marketplace: live GitHub dsh-plugin topic search with per-repo package.json verification (dsh.bundle/dsh.client manifest badges and a verified-only filter), npm-first installs with same-source anti-squatting checks, update detection, and five agent tools for headless use.
description.zh: 开放式插件市场：GitHub dsh-plugin 话题实时搜索，逐仓库 package.json 验证（dsh.bundle/dsh.client 声明徽章与只看已验证过滤），npm 优先安装带同源防抢注校验，更新检测，并附五个可在无界面环境使用的 agent 工具。

description.en: Aggregated web search provider that fans one query out to 11 engines (Exa, Parallel, DuckDuckGo, SearXNG, Brave, Tavily, Serper, Mojeek, DeepSeek, Anthropic, OpenAI) concurrently, URL-dedupes and merges the results. Ships a settings card for toggling backends, storing API keys in the credential store, and tuning concurrency and timeouts.
description.zh: 聚合网络搜索插件：一次查询并发分发到 11 个引擎（Exa、Parallel、DuckDuckGo、SearXNG、Brave、Tavily、Serper、Mojeek、DeepSeek、Anthropic、OpenAI），URL 去重后合并结果。设置面板卡片可开关后端、将 API Key 存入凭证库，并调整并发与超时。

description.en: DSH context-pressure guard: shows session occupancy, warns at 45% and 60% to write the handoff and start a new session, and at 45% auto-drafts the handoff block into your working directory. Registers no tool and injects no prompt, so it costs no context.
description.zh: DSH 上下文守卫：显示会话占用，在 45% 与 60% 提醒你写交接、换新会话，并在 45% 起自动把交接草稿写进你的工作目录。不注册工具、不注入提示词，因此不消耗上下文。

description.en: Runs open-mcp-apps inside DSH: every MCP app gets its own sidebar container with a separate workspace, session, and App mode, an agent status strip under the app, and inline app rendering in ordinary chats.
description.zh: 把 open-mcp-apps 接进 DSH：每个 MCP app 都是侧边栏里自己的容器，带独立 workspace、会话与 App mode，应用下方是 agent 状态条，普通聊天里也能行内渲染 app。

description.en: Browse the awesome-dsh-plugin catalog from a page in DSH Settings: filter by category or by installed state, search by name or description, sort by stars, downloads, name or date added, and install a plugin into the current profile. Two further tabs list what is already installed and which of those have a newer version in the catalog, with an update button on each row. The update view reports installed plugins whose update status cannot be determined, and overlapping install requests are refused. The catalog is cached locally for an hour with a mirror, a CDN and the npm registry as fallbacks when the official source is unreachable.
description.zh: 在 DSH 设置页浏览 awesome-dsh-plugin 目录：按分类或已安装状态筛选，按名称或简介搜索，按 Star、下载量、名称或收录时间排序，一键把插件装进当前 profile。另外两个标签页分别列出已安装的插件、以及其中有更新版本的，并可一键更新。更新页会提示无法判断更新状态的已安装插件，并拒绝同时发起的安装请求。目录在本地缓存一小时，官方源不可达时依次回退到镜像、CDN 与 npm registry。

description.en: OpenCode Console (Zen) models for DeepSeek Harness: paste a Console API key under Settings → Plugins and the Console's chat models become selectable, with the catalog synced automatically, each model routed to the endpoint the official docs assign, and free *-free models hidden by default because they only run inside the OpenCode client.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 接入 OpenCode Console (Zen) 模型：在「设置 → 插件」填入 Console API Key 后即可选用 Console 的对话模型，模型目录自动同步，每个模型按官方文档路由到对应端点，免费 *-free 模型默认不列出（它们只能在 OpenCode 客户端内运行）。

description.en: A whip for DeepSeek V4 Pro: it watches the reasoning fingerprint of every thinking block and pulls the model back when it slips from focused "We will / I will" mode into scattered "let me" mode.
description.zh: 给 DeepSeek V4 Pro 的鞭子：实时监听每个思维块的指纹，当模型从专注的 We will / I will 模式滑向发散的 let me 模式时把它拉回来。

description.en: Image generation workbench and agent tool for DSH: one tool (ark9_generate_image) paints text-to-image and image-to-image via any OpenAI-compatible API. Channels are entirely user-configured - no bundled endpoint, you bring your own baseURL, key and model name (manual input supported). Agent-initiated generations are approval-gated by default: requests queue in the floating panel and nothing bills until you approve; approval is non-blocking (the agent replies "awaiting your approval" immediately, and results, denials or timeouts are injected back so the agent reports them in the next turn). Floating glass workbench with five tabs (Generate / Approvals / Prompts / History / About), aspect-ratio grid with quality-budget + 16px-alignment sizing, transparent background, batch up to 10 images as aggregated sub-tasks, prompt library with custom JSON sources fetched through a host proxy, persistent generation logs with one-click retry, multi-channel aggregation with per-channel model fetching, bilingual UI (zh/en), stroke-SVG icon set, config import/export. Registers as a Better Sidebar tab when dsh-better-sidebar is installed; stacks above the dsh-cua FAB when both are present.
description.zh: DSH 生图工作台与 Agent 生图工具：一个工具（ark9_generate_image）走任意 OpenAI 兼容图片 API 文生图/图生图。渠道完全由用户自行添加——默认零预置，自带 baseURL、Key 与模型名即可（支持手动输入任意模型名）。Agent 发起的生图默认需用户审批：请求进入浮窗审批页，批准才开始生成并计费；审批非阻塞——Agent 立即回复"等你审批"，结果、拒绝或超时以通知注入后续轮次并自动汇报。玻璃拟态浮窗五页签（生成/审批/提示词/记录/说明）、比例网格（质量预算+16px 对齐）、透明背景、批量最多 10 张（子任务聚合，部分成功也返回）、提示词库（自定义 JSON 来源经宿主代理拉取）、生成记录持久化与一键重试、多渠道聚合与逐渠道拉模型、中英双语界面、线性 SVG 图标、配置导入导出。安装 dsh-better-sidebar 自动注册侧栏页签；与 dsh-cua 共存时自动堆叠其悬浮按钮上方。

description.en: Proactive associative memory for DSH: zero-prompt recall injected at a fixed boundary, three-layer auto-consolidation, skill crystallization, and Astra-style context management - handoff ledgers and a PLAN whiteboard that survive context-window switches, water-level sensing with an auto-detected model window. Local Markdown storage, model-agnostic, zero deps; lexical 0GB floor with optional semantic tiers.
description.zh: 主动联想记忆 + Astra 式上下文管理：自动唤回（固定边界注入，前缀缓存友好）/自动沉淀/技能固化/交接账本与 PLAN 白板跨窗口续命/水位感知（窗口自动适配当前模型）。本地 Markdown 存储，模型无关，零依赖；词法 0GB 兜底，可选语义档。

description.en: Pull a 3D lever next to the send button and turn the model's reasoning signals into a pixel-art gacha reveal.
description.zh: 在发送按钮旁拉动 3D 拉杆，把模型思维链的文本信号变成一场像素风抽卡演出。

description.en: Self-contained literature library for DSH with optional Zotero export: full-text PDF fetching (Unpaywall/arXiv/custom URL templates), loose Crossref-backed search, APA/GB-T 7714/MLA/Chicago citation generation, a side-panel PDF reader with highlights and notes, and AI-assisted Q&A/translation steered into the current conversation.
description.zh: DSH 内置文献库（可选导出到 Zotero）：通过 Unpaywall/arXiv/自定义 URL 模板获取全文 PDF，Crossref 候选式宽松搜索，APA/GB-T 7714/MLA/Chicago 引用生成，侧窗 PDF 阅读器（高亮与笔记），以及注入当前对话的 AI 问答/翻译。

description.en: Browses and manages user skills already on disk in DSH and supported agent home directories.
description.zh: 浏览和管理 DSH 及受支持 Agent 主目录中已有的用户技能。

description.en: Evidence-first conclusion gate that cross-checks first-hand claims against a durable per-session tool-activity index, blocks unverified guesses and tracks blocked-versus-converted metrics.
description.zh: 实证门——按会话将第一手结论与持久工具活动索引交叉核验、拦截未验证猜测并以台账统计拦截与转化，中英双语界面。

description.en: Workspace-scoped Semgrep SAST tool for DeepSeek Harness with a managed Windows x64 runtime, structured bounded findings, cancellation and timeout controls, and user-approved sandbox escalation. Installs from npm as @aaub-software/dsh-semgrep-sast.
description.zh: 面向 DeepSeek Harness 的工作区内 Semgrep SAST 工具，提供托管 Windows x64 运行时、结构化有界结果、取消与超时控制，以及经用户批准的沙箱权限升级。npm 包名为 @aaub-software/dsh-semgrep-sast。

description.en: One-click temporary tasks for DeepSeek Harness — each task is a disposable timestamped workspace plus its own session, shown as a native sidebar workspace node.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 的临时任务模式：一键创建一次性的时间戳工作区并开会话，直接成为侧边栏原生工作区节点。

description.en: AgentDuel is a code-battle game. This plugin lets you complete the entire game loop inside DSH: manage deathmatch characters and capture-the-flag teams, submit agent code, start battles, watch replays, and use DSH conversations to keep improving agents based on battle results.
description.zh: AgentDuel 是一款代码对战游戏，通过这款插件，在 DSH 内部完成整个游戏过程，实现死斗角色与夺旗团队、提交 Agent 代码、发起战斗、观看回放，并通过 DSH 会话依据战果继续优化 Agent。

description.en: Connects DeepSeek Harness to ReMe's local-first, self-evolving personal knowledge base: automatically captures completed main-agent conversations as user-owned Markdown memory, searches conversations and source material through reme_search with BM25, optional embeddings, and wikilink expansion, and schedules daily memory consolidation.
description.zh: 将 DeepSeek Harness 接入 ReMe 本地优先、自进化的个人知识库：自动把已完成的主 Agent 对话沉淀为用户掌控的 Markdown 记忆，通过 reme_search 结合 BM25、可选向量检索和 wikilink 展开搜索对话与资料，并按日整理长期记忆。

description.en: Dockable DSH Web UI layout that organizes conversations as tabs across draggable split groups.
description.zh: 可停靠的 DSH Web UI 布局插件，将对话组织为标签页，并支持拖拽拆分对话分组。

description.en: Per-event sound notifications: turn completion, approval, question, plan-review, goal-blocked, and task-failure each get their own sound and volume, configurable in the Web UI (built-in synth, mute, or local audio file).
description.zh: 六类事件独立提示音：回合完成、审批、提问、计划评审、目标受阻、任务失败各有独立声音与音量，可在 Web 设置面板配置（内置合成音 / 静音 / 本地音频文件）。

description.en: Deterministic context compression for dsh — zero LLM calls, rule-based pruning that preserves paths, commands, error traces, and open todos verbatim. Compresses ~80k tokens to a few hundred.
description.zh: dsh 的确定性上下文压缩后端：零 LLM 摘要调用，基于规则剪枝，逐字保留路径/命令/报错原文/未完成 todo，约 8 万 token 压到几百。

description.en: Register locally-defined custom agents as callable subagents in dsh: the main conversation invokes any agent by name via use_agent, each running as a real dsh subagent with its own persona. Supports breakpoint resume for interrupted runs.
description.zh: 把本地定义的自定义 agent 注册成 dsh 可调用的 subagent：主模型通过 use_agent 工具按名字派活，每个 agent 以独立人格运行，支持断点续跑。

description.en: Full-featured TUI for DeepSeek Harness: streaming conversation, powerline status bar, real-time think/tool/todo panels, subagent dual-view, theme hot-switch — all as pure cordis plugins with zero upstream patches.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 的全功能 TUI：流式对话、powerline 状态栏、实时思考/工具/待办面板、子代理双视图、主题热切换——全部以纯 cordis 插件实现，不 fork、不 patch 上游一行代码。

description.en: Evidence-bound negative-knowledge ledger: persists disproven paths (command_failed, file_missing) with their outcome and precondition evidence, then warns or blocks repeat attempts until the evidence changes.
description.zh: 证据约束的负面知识账本：记录被证伪的路径（command_failed / file_missing）及其结果与前置条件证据，重复尝试时警告或拦截，证据变化后自动解除。

description.en: Web GUI convenience suite with appearance controls, timeline navigation, project folders, prompts, conversation export, Mermaid rendering, quote reply, and DeepSeek balance and daily token usage.
description.zh: DSH Web GUI 便利套件，提供外观控制、时间线导航、项目文件夹、提示词、会话导出、Mermaid 渲染、引用回复，以及 DeepSeek 余额和每日 token 用量。

description.en: Runs one-time and RFC 5545 recurring Agent tasks in fresh DSH sessions, with visual schedule editing and session-linked history.
description.zh: 在全新的 DSH 会话中运行单次或 RFC 5545 周期 Agent 任务，支持可视化计划编辑和会话关联历史。

description.en: A shared kanban board that lets people and DSH agents manage workspace tasks through a Board tab and kanban tools.
description.zh: 一个由用户与 DSH Agent 共同维护的工作区看板，通过看板标签页和 kanban 工具管理任务。

description.en: A minimal worktree management solution with only one button and one dialog.
description.zh: 极简 worktree 管理方案，只有一个按钮和一个弹窗。

description.en: A2A protocol server for dsh agents, with JSON-RPC tasks, SSE streaming, cancellation, and an agent card.
description.zh: 为 dsh agent 提供 A2A 协议服务，支持 JSON-RPC 任务、SSE 流式输出、取消任务和 agent card。

description.en: Send dsh turn traces, LLM generations, tool spans, and subagent activity to Langfuse.
description.zh: 将 dsh 的会话轮次、LLM 调用、工具调用及子 agent 活动记录到 Langfuse。

description.en: Apply configurable allow, deny, and approval rules to dsh tool calls, including shell command patterns.
description.zh: 根据可配置的允许、拒绝和审批规则控制 dsh 工具调用，包括对 shell 命令的匹配。

description.en: Mirror dsh session events to MySQL, PostgreSQL, SQLite, or SQL Server while retaining local session files.
description.zh: 将 dsh 会话事件镜像到 MySQL、PostgreSQL、SQLite 或 SQL Server，同时保留本地会话文件。

description.en: Provider-aware account balance chip for the DSH sidebar, showing the active model provider balance for DeepSeek, OpenRouter, Moonshot/Kimi, Zhipu/GLM, and MiniMax, plus DeepSeek peak/off-peak status.
description.zh: DSH 侧边栏的账户余额胶囊，跟随当前模型的服务商显示余额，支持 DeepSeek、OpenRouter、Moonshot/Kimi、Zhipu/GLM 与 MiniMax，并显示 DeepSeek 高峰/空闲时段。

description.en: Tracks DeepSeek Harness LLM token usage and cost (CNY, peak/off-peak pricing) with a settings dashboard, agent tools, HTTP API and persistent storage.
description.zh: 统计 DeepSeek Harness 的 LLM Token 用量与花费（人民币、峰谷计价），提供设置面板、Agent 工具、HTTP 接口与持久化存储。

description.en: Accessibility-first macOS computer use: fresh observations, stale-state rejection, scoped permissions, and safe input.
description.zh: macOS 电脑控制：Accessibility 观测、过期状态拒绝、作用域权限与安全输入。

description.en: Rewind conversation and workspace state, powered by a persistent Change Ledger.
description.zh: 对话回退：基于持久 Change Ledger 回滚会话与工作区状态。

description.en: Vision for text-only models: paste an image and the model switches to a Vision Toolkit variant for image Q&A, multi-image comparison, long-screenshot OCR, screenshot-to-UI reproduction, element grounding, and pixel diff. No API key by default — images are processed by the author-hosted free service, 100 per machine per day; configurable to your own provider.
description.zh: 让纯文本模型处理视觉任务：粘贴图片后自动切换到 Vision Toolkit 变体，支持图片问答、多图比较、长截图 OCR、截图还原前端 UI、元素定位与像素对比。默认无需 API Key——图片经作者自建的免费服务处理，每台机器每天 100 张；也可改为指向自己的服务商。

description.en: J-Space Cognition Suite SV1 native agent preset and standalone Cordis plugin: 13 modules, persistent controller and decoupled workspace.
description.zh: J-Space Cognition Suite SV1 原生智能体预设与 Cordis 插件：提供 13 大认知工程模块、持久化控制器与状态外化工作区。

description.en: Self-contained browser runtime: Playwright (chromium) + OpenCLI as plugin-local dependencies (global reuse fallback), exposes a `browser` service and 9 interactive browser tools.
description.zh: 自包含浏览器运行时：Playwright（chromium）+ OpenCLI 作为插件本地依赖（全局复用回退），提供 `browser` 服务与 9 个交互式浏览器工具。

description.en: Diagnose duplicate DSH loader entry IDs before startup, report version-locked repair status in a read-only settings card, and apply or revert audited loader repairs through an external CLI.
description.zh: 在 DSH 启动前诊断重复的 loader entry ID，通过只读设置卡片报告版本锁定的修复状态，并使用外部 CLI 应用或撤销经过审计的 loader 修复。

description.en: AnySearch-powered real-time web and vertical search provider for DeepSeek Harness.
description.zh: 基于 AnySearch 的实时网页与垂直搜索插件，为 DeepSeek Harness 提供搜索工具。

description.en: Model channel manager: several provider/model candidates share one virtual route (roundrobin/<group>) with failover, retry, timeout and cooldown; a settings tab edits providers and groups, runs per-model speed tests and real single-model request tests, and a seven-day health panel aggregates latency, failures and upstream token usage (input, output, cache and reasoning).
description.zh: 模型渠道管理：多个供应商/模型候选共享一条虚拟路由（roundrobin/组），带失败转移、重试、超时与冷却；设置页签可编辑供应商与轮询组、跑测速与单模型真实请求测试，健康面板聚合七天延迟、失败与上游 token 用量（输入、输出、缓存、推理）。

description.en: Session model selector with search: two-stage loose matching (normalised substring first, subsequence as fallback, so glm53 finds GLM-5.3 and ds finds DeepSeek), providers with recent successful calls pinned first, and a reasoning-effort pane that remembers each model's last explicitly chosen effort.
description.zh: 搜索增强的会话模型选择器：两段式宽松匹配（先归一化子串，未命中再退子序列，glm53 命中 GLM-5.3、ds 命中 DeepSeek）、近七天成功调用过的供应商置顶，推理档位面板记住每个模型上次显式选择的档位。

description.en: Tavily search and page fetch: tavily_search queries with a rotating pool of up to eight API keys that backs off per key on 401/403/429 so one exhausted account does not take the tool down, and web_fetch retrieves a single page through curl, returning its HTTP status with de-tagged text.
description.zh: Tavily 检索与网页抓取：tavily_search 带最多八把 API key 的轮询池，按 key 对 401/403/429 退避，单个账号额度耗尽不再等于工具失效；web_fetch 经 curl 抓取单页，返回 HTTP 状态与去标签正文。

description.en: Teaching board view: agent-generated self-contained HTML is projected into a sandboxed iframe as a board, annotated by hand (brush, four colours, eraser, undo), extended in place across several tool calls, and screenshotted back into the conversation as a real user message.
description.zh: 教学平面视图：agent 生成的自包含 HTML 投影进沙箱 iframe 当板书，可用画笔手写勾画（四色、橡皮、撤销）、在同一块板上增量续写，并把画面截图作为真实用户消息发回对话。

description.en: Routes DSH filesystem, shell, subprocess, and PTY operations to local, SSH, and Docker execution nodes, with a node registry, an authentication gate, a mobile-aware management UI, and per-workspace custom project instructions.
description.zh: 为 DSH 提供多节点执行路由，将文件系统、Shell、子进程和 PTY 操作分发到本地、SSH 与 Docker 执行节点，并包含节点注册表、认证门禁、移动端管理 UI，以及可注入新对话的工作区自定义项目指令。

description.en: An unofficial Arknights P.R.T.S.-inspired interface theme for DSH Web with appearance presets, accessibility controls, and conversation navigation.
description.zh: 面向 DSH Web 的非官方明日方舟 P.R.T.S. 风格界面主题，提供外观预设、辅助功能与会话导航。

description.en: Literature search for DeepSeek Harness: pubmed_search, pubmed_paper and pubmed_related over the official NCBI E-utilities (including elink related-article ranking), plus scholar_search and scholar_cite (MLA/APA/Chicago/Harvard/Vancouver/BibTeX via SerpApi). Both backends return one paper shape, and a settings card configures the API keys, the Scholar backend and the rate/result limits.
description.zh: 面向 DeepSeek Harness 的文献检索：pubmed_search、pubmed_paper、pubmed_related 走官方 NCBI E-utilities（含 elink 相关文献排序），scholar_search、scholar_cite 走 Google Scholar（MLA/APA/Chicago/Harvard/Vancouver/BibTeX，需 SerpApi 后端）。两个后端统一为同一种 paper 结构，设置卡片可配置 API key、Scholar 后端与速率/条数上限。

description.en: OpenCode GO quota widget pinned to the sidebar, with rolling/weekly/monthly usage bars, an elapsed-versus-remaining time bar under each, a same-origin usage proxy, an /opencode-go command, and the runtime x-opencode-session fix for GO gateway chat requests. Fork of yumusb/dsh-opencode-go-usage.
description.zh: 常驻侧边栏的 OpenCode GO 套餐额度组件：滚动/周/月三条用量条、每条下方一条已流逝与剩余时间条、同源用量代理、/opencode-go 命令，以及针对 GO 网关聊天请求的运行时 x-opencode-session 修复。fork 自 yumusb/dsh-opencode-go-usage。

description.en: Connects DeepSeek Harness to Avernet's Bot Collaboration Network over WebSocket V2, with automatic onboarding, isolated agent sessions, tool-call events, and multi-bot routing tools.
description.zh: 通过 WebSocket V2 将 DeepSeek Harness 接入 Avernet Bot 协作网络，支持自动注册、Agent 会话隔离、工具调用事件和多 Bot 路由工具。

description.en: Provides DeepSeek Harness agents with native identities based on the open Agent Network Protocol (ANP), plus identity-based direct, group, mail, and Agent-to-Agent communication.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 智能体提供基于开放协议ANP的原生身份，以及基于该身份的私聊、群聊、邮件和智能体间通信能力。

description.en: Shows OpenCode Go quota usage in the web sidebar's bottom-left corner — rolling/weekly/monthly progress with a hover card, plus a Beijing-time DeepSeek peak-hour timeline.
description.zh: 在 Web 侧边栏左下角显示 OpenCode Go 用量——滚动/本周/本月配额进度与悬停明细卡片，并附按北京时间标记的 DeepSeek 高峰时段进度条。

description.en: Trellis-style workflow for DeepSeek Harness: per-turn phase breadcrumbs via agent/pre-step, bundled skill provider, and DSH-native task/phase state with git-cleanliness guardrails.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 打造的 Trellis 风格工作流：基于 agent/pre-step 的每轮速记注入、内置技能提供方，以及带 git 清洁度护栏的 DSH 原生任务与相位状态管理。

description.en: Fold completed turns into their final conclusions, split thinking from prose with a divider, and jump between turns from a rail dockable left or right with line or dot marks, an optional ring and hover summaries; it can hide the host right-edge TurnNavigator, load earlier history, and open a pre-filled diagnostics issue.
description.zh: 已完成轮次折叠成最终结论、思考与正文之间插入分隔线、可贴左缘或右缘的定位条（横线 / 圆点标记、可选外圈、悬停摘要 + 点击跳转）；还可隐藏宿主原生右缘 TurnNavigator、加载更早历史、一键打开预填好的诊断报告 issue。

description.en: A configurable 17-segment session status bar for the dsh composer dock with live TPS, per-model cost estimation, and a usage & cost dialog.
description.zh: 输入栏下可配置的 17 段会话状态栏，提供实时 TPS、按模型分别计价的费用估算，以及用量与费用弹窗。

description.en: \!WARNING\! this removes the authentication step !WARNING! Exchanges the process launch token for the browser-session cookie, so a first visit needs no ?token=... in the URL.
description.zh: ！警告！这会移除认证步骤！警告！注册一个登录入口路由（默认 GET /__dsh_login），把进程里的登录 token 换成浏览器会话 cookie，让首次访问不用带 ?token=…。

description.en: Independent per-pane zoom for the DSH web shell: Ctrl+wheel over a pane, Ctrl+± / Ctrl+0 for the focused pane. Works with the official look and every skin.
description.zh: 支持 DSH Web 上的每个面板独立缩放：鼠标悬浮在面板上 Ctrl+滚轮，或对选中的面板 Ctrl+±，Ctrl+0恢复。兼容官方界面风格及皮肤。

description.en: Codex-style left-gutter tick rail for each user turn, with hover preview and click-to-scroll.
description.zh: 对话区左侧 Codex 风格短横线锚点，悬停预览，点击跳转到对应轮次。

description.en: Voice call assistant for the DSH desktop app and the Web GUI (the same plugin, only the profile name differs): a draggable floating call ball, browser-side VAD that sends each utterance after a pause, speech recognition through the local SenseVoice model already downloaded by the official voice-input plugin (no second model), FunASR HTTP or streaming, or a cloud-compatible API, MiniMax / MiMo-V2.5-TTS (director mode and voice clone) / OpenAI-compatible TTS replies, an optional wake-word mode with auto-sleep, and task dispatch to separate sessions with progress, stop, and spoken completion reports.
description.zh: DSH 桌面端与 Web GUI 通用（同一份插件，只是 profile 名不同）的个人语音通话助手：可拖拽悬浮球通话面板、浏览器端 VAD（停顿自动发送）、语音识别可选本地 SenseVoice（复用官方「语音输入」插件已下载的模型，免装第二份模型）/ FunASR HTTP 或流式 / 云端兼容 API、MiniMax / MiMo-V2.5-TTS（含导演模式与音色克隆）/ OpenAI 兼容 TTS 语音回复、可开关的唤醒词模式（沉默自动休眠），以及把任务分发给独立子会话并跟踪进度、停止与完成播报。

description.en: Connects DeepSeek Harness to Busabase: search workspace knowledge, work with structured records and apps, submit writes as reviewable ChangeRequests, and inspect results in live cards.
description.zh: 把 DeepSeek Harness 接入 Busabase：检索工作区知识、操作结构化记录与应用、将写入提交为可审阅的 ChangeRequest，并在实时卡片中查看结果。

description.en: Adds touch-friendly navigation, layout refinements, and standalone PWA styling to the existing DeepSeek Harness web interface.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 现有 Web 界面加上触屏友好的导航、布局微调与独立 PWA 样式。

description.en: Controls your real Chrome from DSH over a local WebSocket bridge: tab management, navigation, DOM snapshots, page JS evaluation, clicks, typing, screenshots, waits and dialog handling behind a Settings toggle.
description.zh: 通过本地 WebSocket 桥接让 DSH 操控你的真实 Chrome：标签页管理、导航、DOM 快照、页面 JS 求值、点击输入、截图、等待与弹窗处理，默认关闭需在设置中开启。

description.en: Seven agent-preset modes for DeepSeek Harness, each with a fixed tool boundary, per-mode model routing and fast/deep omd_task delegation tiers, plus a plan-to-execute loop (/mode, /start-work, goal-backed /ulw) and a settings page that remaps models per mode and per tier.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供 7 个 Agent 预设模式：每个模式固定工具边界、按模式路由模型，并以 fast/deep 档位委派 omd_task 子代理；含规划到执行闭环（/mode、/start-work、基于 goal 的 /ulw）与逐模式、逐档位重配模型的设置页。

description.en: DeepSeek usage dashboard for DSH Web: days-left estimate from recent average spend, daily/monthly/cumulative costs with period-over-period comparison, per-model cost ranking, cache savings, peak/off-peak pricing impact, and a draggable floating balance widget.
description.zh: DSH Web 的 DeepSeek 用量仪表盘：按近期日均消耗估算可用天数，今日/本月/累计花费环比对照，分模型成本排行、缓存节省、峰谷定价影响，以及可拖动的悬浮余额窗。

description.en: Adds a celebratory fireworks overlay to the DSH Web UI through a happy_fireworks agent tool.
description.zh: 通过 `happy_fireworks` Agent 工具为 DSH Web UI 增加庆祝礼花覆盖层。

description.en: Configurable deterministic session titles for DeepSeek Harness from semantic prompt fields and templates.
description.zh: 基于语义 prompt 字段与自定义模板的 DeepSeek Harness 确定性会话标题生成插件。

description.en: Adds a Worktree view to DSH Web UI that groups Sessions by Git worktree while keeping DSH as the source of truth.
description.zh: 为 DSH Web UI 增加按 Git Worktree 组织 Session 的视角，同时继续由 DSH 管理原始 Project 和 Session 数据。

description.en: Escaped, theme-aware HTML code-block rendering service for DSH Web plugins, built on structured syntax-highlight tokens with source line-ending preservation.
description.zh: 面向 DSH Web 插件的转义与主题响应 HTML 代码块渲染服务，基于结构化语法高亮 token，并保留源码换行符。

description.en: Personal paste inbox for DeepSeek Harness (dsh): /inbox in the composer or the sidebar panel files links, images, text and credentials into a local vault, classifies them by local rules and then by a rate-capped model pass, and browses, searches and edits them from the panel; the assistant retrieves records on request in conversation, credential bodies stay encrypted at rest, and an optional WebDAV or S3 remote syncs records and attachment bytes. Windows only so far.
description.zh: dsh 的个人收件箱：输入框的 /inbox 或侧栏面板把链接、图片、文本与账密收进本地仓库，先按本地规则、再由有每日上限的模型分类，可在面板里筛选、搜索与编辑；对话里让助手按需检索取回，账密正文加密落盘，可选 WebDAV 或 S3 远端同步记录与附件字节。目前只在 Windows 实测。

description.en: Select text → annotate → send with your message; replies map back to each annotation.
description.zh: 选中文字→批注→随消息发送，回复按批注逐条对照。

description.en: Interactive UI components rendered inline in replies: layout, charts, forms, quizzes, mermaid, 3D scenes, and an action event loop back to the model.
description.zh: 助手回复内渲染交互式 UI 组件：布局、图表、表单、测验、mermaid、3D 场景与回传事件循环。

description.en: Markdown visual enhancement and session workbench for DSH Web Composer: live syntax presentation with caret-row source reveal (inactive-line markers can be hidden or faded), deterministic local completions, and list/quote continuation on line break with ordered-list renumbering; long pastes fold into persistent chips with inline context or file-mode delivery (@path across 50+ extensions) plus sidebar LLM rewrites (stop, preview diff, undo/redo); real-time context map with token gauge, composition breakdown, per-turn growth chart with anchor lines, in-place /compact, turn forking, and a Context Doctor workspace (overview, diagnostics, analysis, feedback).
description.zh: DSH Web Composer 视觉增强与会话工作台：实时 Markdown 呈现与光标行源码还原（非焦点行语法标记可完全隐藏或淡化显示）、确定性本地补全、列表与引用的换行自动续行及有序列表重编号；超长粘贴自动收纳为持久化引用 chip，支持直接内联或文件送达（支持 50+ 种扩展名），并在右栏抽屉提供大模型智能改写（支持中止、预览对比、应用与撤销重做）；集成实时上下文地图，包含 Token 仪表盘、构成穿透钻取、逐轮增长图与锚定刻线、一键 /compact 及会话分叉，并内置 Context Doctor 工作区（概览、诊断、分析、反馈）。

description.en: CapMap docs visualization with Obsidian-style semantic graph and capability panel.
description.zh: CapMap 文档体系可视化：Obsidian 风格语义图谱与能力面板。

description.en: Registers the DeepSeek Harness web server (dsh web) as an auto-start, self-healing background service — LaunchAgent / systemd / cron plus a 30s health-check watchdog — with seven dsh_daemon_* tools (install/uninstall/reinstall/status/start/stop/update).
description.zh: 将 DeepSeek Harness 的 web 服务（dsh web）注册为自启动、自愈的后台服务：LaunchAgent / systemd / cron 加 30 秒健康检查 watchdog，并提供 7 个 dsh_daemon_* 工具（安装/卸载/重装/状态/启动/停止/更新）。

description.en: Auditable token ledger for DeepSeek Harness: folds the durable session log into restart-safe totals, recomputes the same numbers from the raw logs and diffs them, and turns usage into a bill by workspace, session, model or vendor, exportable as CSV or JSON.
description.zh: 可审计的 DSH token 账本：把持久化会话日志折算成重启安全的总量，可从原始日志重算并比对差异，并按工作区、会话、模型或厂商生成账单，可导出 CSV 或 JSON。

description.en: DeepSeek account balance in the dsh web sidebar footer with live config hot reload and an editable Settings → Plugins card.
description.zh: 在 DSH Web 侧边栏底部展示 DeepSeek 账户余额，支持配置热重载与可编辑的设置 → 插件卡片。

description.en: DSH sidebar footer ordering: forces the sidebar.footer.action slot into a vertical stack and lets users configure the top-to-bottom order of its entries.
description.zh: DSH 侧边栏页脚排序：将 sidebar.footer.action 槽位改为上下堆叠，并允许用户配置各条目自上而下的排列顺序。

description.en: Archived-session manager for DSH Web: workspace-grouped list, FTS5 full-text search over session content with per-session snippets, restore-and-open, and hard delete.
description.zh: 归档会话管理插件：按工作区分组浏览，FTS5 全文检索会话内容并展示多条命中摘要，支持恢复并打开与彻底删除。

description.en: Shows the running agent step above the web composer as a Chinese sentence: its step number, the tools it is running, and how long it has been going. A finished step keeps its duration on screen until the next one starts, so a slow step can be identified after the fact.
description.zh: 在网页版输入框上方用一句中文显示当前正在执行的智能体步骤：步号、正在执行的工具、以及已运行多久。步骤结束后会保留该步用时，直到下一步开始，因此慢步骤事后也能查证。

description.en: Tencent CloudBase backend for DeepSeek Harness — scaffold and deploy full-stack apps from chat, render query results as table cards with paging, sorting and CSV export, preview a deployment on its domain, and call the CloudBase MCP toolset (`mcp__cloudbase__*`) with device-code login.
description.zh: 把腾讯云 CloudBase 后端接入 DeepSeek Harness——在对话里搭好并部署全栈应用，查询结果渲染为表格卡片（分页、排序、导出 CSV），部署后可预览真实域名，并提供 CloudBase MCP 工具集（`mcp__cloudbase__*`），登录走 device-code 流程。

description.en: Self-evolving team memory as plain Markdown in git: a native Cordis plugin that registers 38 bare-name memory tools plus a prompt-signals section re-evaluated at every assembly, with RPE reinforcement, decay and sleep consolidation; shares one data repo with its Claude Code (MCP) and OpenClaw hosts; verified against DSH 0.1.0-rc.6.
description.zh: 自进化团队记忆，以纯 Markdown 存于 Git：原生 Cordis 插件注册 38 个裸名记忆工具，并按每次组装动态注入 prompt-signals 段；含 RPE 强化、衰减与睡眠巩固；与 Claude Code（MCP）、OpenClaw 宿主共享同一数据仓；已对 DSH 0.1.0-rc.6 实测。

description.en: A persistent agent team for long-running collaboration in DeepSeek Harness: durable agent identities, per-project Workspaces, responsibility-bearing Channels, and Task Threads chaining session agents.
description.zh: 给 DSH 一个可长期协作的持久 Agent 团队：Agent 是持久身份，Workspace 按项目组织，Channel 承载职责分派，Task Thread 串联多个 session agent 协作推进。

description.en: Renders assistant replies with numbered citation chips and a sources panel for web-search results, inline pictures with their source captions, and KaTeX formulas, Mermaid diagrams and highlighted code in streaming Markdown.
description.zh: 为助手回答渲染带编号的引用角标和来源面板（针对联网搜索结果）、带来源说明的正文配图，并在流式 Markdown 中渲染 KaTeX 公式、Mermaid 图和代码高亮。

description.en: Computer use for Windows: screenshot, mouse, keyboard, clipboard and window tools with per-app access that goes through DSH approval; while the agent is in control the screen shows an orange glow and a status bar, and Esc pauses or resumes.
description.zh: Windows 电脑控制：截图、鼠标、键盘、剪贴板和窗口工具，按应用授权并经 DSH 审批；操控期间屏幕显示橙色光晕和提示条，按 Esc 暂停或继续。

description.en: Web search provider with switchable engines, several usable without an API key (Bing, DuckDuckGo, SearXNG and others) and a fallback order between them; adds multi_search, platform_search, image_search with an in-chat image wall, page_images and save_images, plus a settings page for engines, keys and per-engine proxy.
description.zh: 可切换引擎的联网搜索 provider，其中多个引擎无需 API key（Bing、DuckDuckGo、SearXNG 等），可设置回退顺序；另提供 multi_search、platform_search、带对话内图片墙的 image_search、page_images 和 save_images，以及配置引擎、密钥和按引擎代理的设置页。

description.en: Image generation with a sidebar gallery page and three agent tools (paint_image, paint_images, edit_painting); preset providers include ModelScope, Google Gemini, OpenAI, SiliconFlow, Volcengine Seedream, Alibaba DashScope, xAI and Zhipu, plus any OpenAI-compatible endpoint, each with its own proxy setting.
description.zh: 图像生成：侧边栏画廊页面和三个 Agent 工具（paint_image、paint_images、edit_painting）；预置 ModelScope、Google Gemini、OpenAI、硅基流动、火山方舟 Seedream、阿里云百炼、xAI、智谱等服务商，也可接入任意 OpenAI 兼容端点，每个服务商可单独设置代理。

description.en: Windows only: the agent edits documents inside the Word, Excel and PowerPoint (Microsoft Office or WPS Office) windows you have open, through the applications' automation interface, so changes appear live and you can edit alongside; it reads structure, applies batches of edits, renders pages to images to check layout, and saves or exports PDF.
description.zh: 仅 Windows：Agent 通过办公软件的自动化接口，直接在你打开的 Word、Excel、PowerPoint（微软 Office 或 WPS Office）窗口里改文档，改动实时出现，你可以同时编辑；可读取结构、批量修改、把页面渲染成图片核对排版、保存或导出 PDF。

description.en: Network proxy settings page for DeepSeek Harness: set a global HTTP(S) proxy with bypass hosts, or give each LLM provider its own proxy or a direct connection; changes apply on save without a restart.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 网络代理设置页：配置全局 HTTP(S) 代理及免代理主机，或为单个 LLM 提供商单独指定代理或直连；保存即生效，无需重启。

description.en: Continue the sessions on your computer from a phone browser: scan a QR code, approve the device on the computer, then chat, answer approvals, browse workspace files and manage settings in a mobile interface; connects over the same Wi-Fi or through a Cloudflare Quick Tunnel.
description.zh: 用手机浏览器继续电脑上的会话：扫码并在电脑上确认设备后，在移动端界面里对话、处理审批、浏览工作区文件、管理设置；支持同一 Wi-Fi 直连或经 Cloudflare Quick Tunnel 连接。

description.en: Per provider/model generation concurrency, with a settings card: a cap on how many sessions may stream at once, enforced at the stream and again at subagent spawn, where a fan-out past the cap waits in a FIFO queue instead of failing.
description.zh: 按提供方/模型限制并发生成，并附带设置卡片：限定同时进行流式生成的会话数，在流式调用与子代理派生两处强制执行；超出上限的扇出会进入 FIFO 队列等待，而不是直接失败。

description.en: Config-driven lifecycle hooks, including context injection: declare event, handler and outcome in YAML, where the handler is an in-harness tool (MCP included), a shell command or an HTTP endpoint, and the outcome is model-visible context, a denied tool call, or fire-and-forget.
description.zh: 以配置驱动的生命周期钩子，并支持上下文注入：在 YAML 中声明事件、处理器与结果——处理器可以是进程内工具（含 MCP）、shell 命令或 HTTP 端点，结果可以是模型可见的上下文、拒绝该次工具调用，或触发即忘。

description.en: Deep research as an agent mode: one reviewed loop that plans, researches in adaptive parallel rounds driven by the gaps the researchers themselves declare, synthesises a cited report and then reviews it adversarially, instead of a script the model rewrites per call. Questions the round budget never reached are named in the report rather than dropped.
description.zh: 把深度研究做成一种代理模式：一条经过审阅的固定循环——先规划，再按研究员自行声明的缺口进行自适应并行轮次，综合出带引用的报告，最后对其做对抗性审阅——而不是让模型每次现写脚本。轮次预算未能覆盖的问题会在报告中被逐一点名，而不是被悄悄丢弃。

description.en: Points web_search at a self-hosted SearXNG instance instead of the native route: pages until maxResults is satisfied, and reports degraded coverage when engines fail so a thin result set is not read as a thin web.
description.zh: 把 web_search 指向自建的 SearXNG 实例而非原生搜索路由：自动翻页直到满足 maxResults，并在引擎失败时报告覆盖不全，避免把稀少的结果误读成网上本就没有内容。

description.en: A-share market dashboard for DeepSeek Harness: realtime market indices, stock screener with 13 technical signals and multi-strategy intersection, 7×24 multi-source news aggregation, watchlist with group management, market sentiment thermometer (limit-up ladder, breadth), K-line charts with MA/EXPMA/BOLL overlays, and sector/limit-up/longhu rankings.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness A 股行情面板：实时大盘指数、技术选股（13 项信号 + 多策略交叉）、7×24 多源快讯聚合、自选股分组管理、市场情绪温度计（连板梯队/涨跌家数）、K 线图（MA/EXPMA/BOLL 叠加）、板块榜/涨停池/龙虎榜。

description.en: JARVIS-style sci-fi HUD shell over the DSH web GUI: electric-cyan VITAL SIGNS / RT-MONITOR / RT-LOG left bar, POWER CORE gauges and a rotating RADAR scan disc on the right with up/down traffic chart, filesystem browser with file preview, and a terminal-styled composer with a JARVIS header strip that follows the active workspace.
description.zh: 在 DSH Web 界面上叠加 JARVIS 风格科幻 HUD 外壳：电光青色 VITAL SIGNS 生命体征 / RT-MONITOR 实时监控 / RT-LOG 事件日志左栏，右侧 POWER CORE 能源核心仪表、旋转扫描的 RADAR 雷达盘与上下行流量图，左下文件系统浏览器（带文件预览），以及带 JARVIS 头部横幅、跟随当前工作区的终端风格输入框。

description.en: eDEX-UI-style shell over the DSH web GUI: system-telemetry left bar with per-core CPU sparklines, encom-globe world-map right bar with up/down traffic chart, filesystem browser with file preview, and a terminal-styled composer that follows the active workspace.
description.zh: 在 DSH Web 界面上叠加 eDEX-UI 风格外壳：左侧系统遥测栏（含每核 CPU 迷你趋势图）、右侧 encom-globe 世界地图与上下行流量图、左下文件系统浏览器（带文件预览），以及跟随当前工作区的终端风格输入框。

description.en: eDEX-UI-style shell over the DSH web GUI themed as an XRY/B1 medical HUD: ECG heartbeat waveform and a rotating radar scan disc on the right bar, power-gen energy-cell meters on the left bar, a DATA TIMELINE scan-log table on the bottom, all in a cyan-on-near-black CRT skin around the original UI.
description.zh: 以 XRY/B1 医疗 HUD 为主题色的 eDEX-UI 风格 DSH 外壳：右侧 ECG 心电波形与旋转雷达扫描盘、左侧能量条仪表、底部 DATA TIMELINE 扫描日志表，青蓝近黑 CRT 皮肤包裹原始界面。

description.en: Prevents request context bloat in DeepSeek Harness: catalogs MCP tools and skills under ctx.capability, exposes them in exposed/progressive/blocked tiers, and invokes low-frequency ones on demand via meta_search/meta_invoke, with a visual settings tab.
description.zh: 解决海量 MCP 工具/技能塞满请求、挤占上下文的问题：统一编目能力（ctx.capability），以常驻/按需/禁用三档控制暴露与执行，低频能力按需经 meta_search/meta_invoke 检索执行，并附可视化「能力菜单」设置页。

description.en: Create editable Blender models in DSH with linked speaker, cup and lamp dimensions. Resize moved, tilted and animated speaker assemblies while retaining manual details, cameras and timing; author bounded control meshes, subdivision, repeated copies and seeded placement on closed static surfaces. Inspect native object-axis dimensions, local samples and subject-aware multi-view images; immutable revisions and an approval gate preserve edits, with 18 tools for modeling, review and delivery.
description.zh: 在 DSH 中创建可编辑的 Blender 模型，联动音箱、杯与灯具尺寸。修改已移动、倾斜并带动画的音箱装配，保留手工细节、摄影和时序；支持有预算的控制网格、细分、重复副本及静态闭合表面确定性布置。核对原生物体轴尺寸、局部采样与指定主体多视图；不可变历史和审批闸门保留修改，18 个工具支持建模、评审与交付。

description.en: Claude Code-style full-screen terminal UI: pixel-whale header, live status line, and streaming thought expansion.
description.zh: Claude Code 风格全屏终端 UI：像素鲸鱼顶栏、实时工作状态行、思考流式展开。

description.en: Calendar and hierarchical task workbench: AI-assisted intake clarification, consultation, decomposition, execution with user acceptance, and review, plus reminders and per-task AI session workspaces.
description.zh: 日历 + 层级任务个人工作台：AI 辅助澄清、咨询、拆解、执行（用户验收）与复盘，支持到期提醒与按任务组织的 AI 会话工作区。

description.en: Git Changes tab for the DSH web GUI: staging, diffing, AI-drafted commit messages, branch/merge/stash/worktree operations and sync, with live updates via fs.watch plus a changeToken poll.
description.zh: Git 更改标签页：暂存、对比、AI 起草提交信息、分支/合并/储藏/工作树操作与同步，通过 fs.watch 加 changeToken 轮询实现实时更新。

description.en: Replaces the headless startup to add --model provider/model, --resume <id|latest>, --continue and --session-info flags to dsh headless runs.
description.zh: 替换无界面启动流程，为 dsh headless 运行添加 --model provider/model、--resume <id|latest>、--continue 与 --session-info 标志。

description.en: A /remember command that writes facts into the AGENTS.md instruction hierarchy dsh already loads, plus a Memory tab showing which instructions the loader kept within its byte budget.
description.zh: /remember 命令将事实写入 dsh 已加载的 AGENTS.md 指令层级，并配有 Memory 标签页，显示加载器在字节预算内实际保留了哪些指令。

description.en: Captures every plan the agent presents through exit_plan_mode as markdown under <workspace>/.dsh/plans, opens a review window, and keeps a Plans history tab recording the outcome of each plan.
description.zh: 将智能体通过 exit_plan_mode 呈现的每个计划捕获为 <workspace>/.dsh/plans 下的 markdown，打开审阅窗口，并以 Plans 历史标签页记录每个计划的结果。

description.en: Skill provider that installs the whole @dennisrongo/skills catalog as one npm dependency, so skills install and update without cloning or linking directories.
description.zh: 技能提供者：将整个 @dennisrongo/skills 目录作为一个 npm 依赖安装，无需克隆仓库或链接目录即可完成技能的安装与更新。

description.en: Serves the obra/superpowers skill catalog to the harness and injects its using-superpowers bootstrap as a persistent, compaction-safe system-prompt section.
description.zh: 向 dsh 提供 obra/superpowers 技能目录，并将其 using-superpowers 引导作为持久、压缩安全的系统提示区块注入。

description.en: Draggable weather bar in the shell overlay with forecast and geocoding from Open-Meteo; the position persists across sessions.
description.zh: shell 浮层中的可拖动天气条，预报与地理编码来自 Open-Meteo；位置跨会话持久保存。

description.en: Registers codex-web-search-mcp as native DSH MCP tools (mcp__codex-web-search__codex_web_search / codex_web_research / web_fetch) for model-independent Codex and Grok web search and deep research.
description.zh: 将 codex-web-search-mcp 注册为 DSH 原生 MCP 工具（codex_web_search / codex_web_research / web_fetch），提供与模型无关的 Codex / Grok 联网搜索与深度研究。

description.en: Complete reverse-skill pack (85 SKILL.md) as a DeepSeek Harness Cordis plugin: reverse engineering, authorized pentesting and security-research skill router.
description.zh: 完整 reverse-skill（85 个 SKILL.md）的 DeepSeek Harness 插件：逆向工程、授权渗透测试与安全研究的技能路由包。

description.en: Complete wuyun-liuqi (five-evolutions-six-qi / 五运六气) Traditional Chinese Medicine skill pack as a DeepSeek Harness Cordis plugin: annual and guest-qi calculation, clinical pattern differentiation, and pathogenesis reasoning.
description.zh: 完整 wuyun-liuqi（五运六气）中医运气学技能包，封装为 DeepSeek Harness 插件：年度与客气推算、临床辨证、病机推演。

description.en: AI image generation for the DSH Web GUI: text-to-image and image-to-image through a configurable OpenAI-compatible endpoint (gpt-image-2 / gpt-image-1 / dall-e-3), with an api_url/api_key settings card and a sidebar split-pane generation studio.
description.zh: 面向 DSH Web GUI 的 AI 生图插件：通过可配置的 OpenAI 兼容端点（gpt-image-2 / gpt-image-1 / dall-e-3）实现文生图与图生图，提供 api_url/api_key 设置卡片与侧边栏分栏生图工作台。

description.en: Notifications for four session states, with browser alerts and prompts.
description.zh: 会话完成等四种状态的通知响应，支持浏览器提示。

description.en: Tracks DSH's file reads, image views, and code edits in WakaTime, including exact counts of lines added and deleted by AI. Keeps activity tracking running while DSH responds, batches updates across files, and coordinates per-project reporting limits across parallel DSH processes. Automatically installs and updates wakatime-cli.
description.zh: 在 WakaTime 中记录 DSH 读取文件、查看图片和编辑代码的活动，并准确统计 AI 新增和删除的代码行数。DSH 回复期间持续记录活动，多个文件的记录批量上报，并在并行运行的 DSH 进程间统一控制各项目的上报频率。自动安装和更新 wakatime-cli。

description.en: Automatic approval and review for tool calls that need approval: keyword buckets match red lines without context, then a judge model classifies what was requested and sends it to allow, reject or a human according to the matching row and risk level; a judgment that never ran always goes to a human, and rejections tell the model why.
description.zh: 自动审批 / 自动审核需要审批的工具调用：先用关键词分桶做零上下文红线匹配，再交由审核模型判类别与风险等级， 按命中行与等级那一格决定自动允许、自动拒绝或转人工；判定没跑成固定转人工，自动拒绝会把原因回传给模型。

description.en: TRAE-style conversation rollback — per-turn checkpoints (10-turn sliding window) roll back touched files and truncate model context in place, keeping the same session id. Human-initiated only: a /rollback command or a per-turn Web button (works on interrupted turns too), with a preview listing each affected file and its action — restore, recover, delete, or skip.
description.zh: TRAE 式「回退到本轮对话发起前」插件：按轮次建立检查点（10 轮滑动窗口），同时回滚工作区文件与原位截断模型上下文，保持同一 session id。回退只能由人发起：/rollback 命令或每轮的 Web 回退按钮（被中断的轮次也可用），弹窗逐条列出受影响文件及其动作（恢复/找回/删除/跳过）。

description.en: Replaces the model button with a Claude Desktop-style model and reasoning-effort switcher, with per-model effort memory, theme-aware styling, smooth slider feel, rounded track, hover highlight, and pixel-dot animation.
description.zh: 将模型按钮替换为Claude Desktop 同款风格的模型与思考力度切换器，支持逐模型记忆力度、主题自适应，滑动手感、圆角轨道、悬停高亮，点阵动画，都是熟悉的味道。

description.en: Two-way sync of DSH sessions, workspace mappings, settings and patches between machines through your own private GitHub repo (API keys stay machine-local).
description.zh: 通过你自己的 GitHub 私有仓库,在多台电脑间双向同步 DSH 会话、工作区对应关系、设置与托管补丁(API 密钥留在本机)。

description.en: Plugin-tree terminal UI for DeepSeek Harness — streaming markdown transcript, tool cards, fuzzy slash commands, and live theming, with every component a hot-swappable Cordis plugin.
description.zh: 插件树式终端界面：流式 markdown 会话流、工具卡片、模糊命令补全与主题热切换，每个界面组件都是可热替换的 Cordis 插件。

description.en: Boot-time watchdog for DSH web: detects broken plugins, disables them persistently so the UI opens, with quarantine audit, automatic probe recovery, and one-click restore.
description.zh: dsh web 启动看门狗：检测并持久化禁用问题插件，让界面正常打开，并提供隔离账本、探针自动恢复与一键恢复。

description.en: DSH-side remote session driver for the dsh-overdrive chat gateway: exposes sessions, trajectory replay and tap-to-approve to Telegram / Discord / Slack / WhatsApp / Feishu / DingTalk / WeCom bridges. Requires running @dsh-overdrive/gateway alongside.
description.zh: dsh-overdrive 聊天网关的 DSH 侧远程会话驱动：把 Telegram / Discord / Slack / WhatsApp / 飞书 / 钉钉 / 企业微信 的会话、轨迹回放与一键审批接入 Harness。需配套运行 @dsh-overdrive/gateway。

description.en: Dedicated model routes, tools, and system guidance for vision, compaction, reviews, subagents, titles, and image generation.
description.zh: 为视觉理解、上下文压缩、审批审查、子代理、会话标题与图片生成提供独立的模型路由、工具与系统提示。

description.en: A GrokBot-style animated avatar with a synchronized typewriter status line — right in front of the "Deep diving..." indicator.
description.zh: 在「Deep diving...」状态提示前，放一只动态小伙伴——GrokBot 风格动画头像，状态文字还会同步打字机变换。

description.en: PC environment diagnostics & port control board: zero-dependency inspection of system, CLI toolchains, active listening ports with hover-to-kill release, and model key readiness. No external calls, zero plaintext secrets.
description.zh: 环境自检与端口控制大屏：零依赖洞察系统架构、12 款核心 CLI 工具链、活跃监听端口与悬浮释放、模型凭据就绪状态。局域网主 IP 一键速查，零外联、零私有凭据明文。

description.en: Fills in what the official pi-ai adapter leaves out on the Models page: gateway reachability probing with latency, one-click pull of the gateway model catalog with checkbox write-back into settings, DeepSeek balance and provider quota shown in place, the protocol and endpoint each provider is actually wired to, and a model dropdown that lists only what works right now — a dead key, an empty balance or an exhausted quota is hidden until you fix it, and comes back on its own.
description.zh: 补上官方 pi-ai 适配器在模型页缺的那半：网关可达性与延迟探测、一键拉取网关模型目录并勾选写回配置、DeepSeek 余额与各家配额就地常驻、每个 provider 实际接入的协议与地址；模型下拉只列当前真能用的分组 —— key 失效、余额耗尽、配额用尽都会被摘掉，修好后自动恢复。

description.en: Make the AI remember how you think, not what you said: actively captures your principles, redlines, and working habits across sessions — with memory capacity, graceful decay, and human-readable reasoning for every entry. 0.7.0 brings an intuitive persona portrait with evidence tracing.
description.zh: 让模型主动记下你的判断依据（原则/红线/工作方式），跨会话复用 —— 有容量上限、会遗忘、每条都说得出为什么记。0.7.0 重构为画像式速写，带证据追溯与红线硬约束，告别冷冰冰的数据库列表。

description.en: Task-queue execution endpoint for DSH: requires a separately self-deployed Hermes Agent gateway plus your own WeChat inbound script; verified on a single environment — expect to adapt it.
description.zh: DSH 的任务队列执行端点：需要自行部署独立的 Hermes Agent 网关并编写自己的微信入站脚本；仅在单一环境验证过，需要按你的环境适配。

description.en: Evidence-first self-evolution controller: bounded Cordis candidate generation, one-shot real-Loader admission, Harbor evaluation, and a crash-resumable journaled lineage.
description.zh: 证据优先的自进化控制器：有界生成 Cordis 候选插件，一次性真实 Loader 准入，Harbor 评测，可崩溃恢复的日志化谱系。

description.en: SSH remote workspace — run bash, file tools, glob and grep on a remote machine over plain sshd (exec + SFTP), zero remote install, purely additive.
description.zh: SSH 远端工作区——在远端机器上执行 bash、文件读写、glob 与 grep（基于 sshd 的 exec + SFTP），远端零安装，纯附加。

description.en: In-app plugin store for the DSH Web UI: browse, search, one-click install, compat badges.
description.zh: DSH Web UI 内置插件商店：浏览、搜索、一键安装、兼容性徽章。

description.en: Shared multi-agent task board (create/claim/transition/query) over a Cordis service key.
description.zh: 多 agent 共享任务板：经 Cordis service key 创建/认领/流转/查询任务。

description.en: Renders Wallpaper Engine scene wallpapers in real time in the browser (three.js player plus a Rust/WASM CPU particle simulation) and plays video and web wallpapers, falling back to the preview image, with no Wallpaper Engine runtime required. Scans the local Steam workshop library (431960) by auto-detection or a manual path, and offers a settings panel for wallpaper selection, library and engine directories, glow, pause and quality.
description.zh: 把本机 Wallpaper Engine 壁纸放到 dsh Web 界面背后：scene 壁纸在浏览器内实时渲染（three.js 播放器 + Rust/WASM CPU 粒子模拟），视频与 web 壁纸原样播放，其余回退 preview 图，不需要安装 Wallpaper Engine 运行时。壁纸库从 Steam 创意工坊目录（431960）自动探测或手动指定，设置面板可选壁纸、配壁纸库与引擎目录、调光晕与暂停/画质。

description.en: Terminal-native TUI frontend for DeepSeek Harness that presents sessions, models, plugins, jobs, subagents, todos, and provider configuration through Harness capabilities while preserving real terminal scrollback.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 的终端原生 TUI 前端，通过 Harness 能力提供会话、模型、插件、任务、子代理、待办事项和 Provider 配置，并保留真实的终端滚动历史。

description.en: Forwards a local dsh web UI to the public internet under a *.ds.hn subdomain (or your own self-hosted relay), gated by a login, with optional end-to-end encryption (PBKDF2 to AES-256-GCM).
description.zh: 把本地 dsh 网页通过带登录门禁的中继转发到公网 *.ds.hn 子域名(也可自托管到自己的域名),支持可选的端到端加密(PBKDF2 到 AES-256-GCM)。

description.en: An independent approval subagent judges every sandbox escalation, with a configurable model and an audit log.
description.zh: 由独立审批子代理裁决每次沙箱提权，可配置审批模型并带审计记录。

description.en: Archived-session manager for DeepSeek Harness: grouped archive panel with restore and delete.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 会话归档管理：分组归档面板，支持恢复与删除。

description.en: Git workspace manager for DeepSeek Harness: a repo-gated composer button opens a settings-style panel for diff/commit, branch, conflict, and worktree management, plus a commit history with branch-graph lines.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 的 Git 工作区管理：输入框「模式」选择器旁的仓库感知入口，打开与设置同规格的面板，覆盖 diff/commit、分支、冲突、worktree 管理与带分支线的提交历史。

description.en: ZCode-style persistent project memory with a full settings manager, index-first injection and agent memory tools.
description.zh: ZCode 风格持久化项目记忆：设置内完整管理页、索引式注入与 agent 记忆工具。

description.en: Per-model system prompt injector for DeepSeek Harness: append custom prompt text to the END of the system prompt for locally configured models, matched by exact provider/model route or a provider-wide provider/* rule (both stack in order). A Settings page lists every configured provider and its models for per-route editing with instant effect, and rules persist to DSH_HOME so they survive restarts. Applies to main sessions, subagents, and workflow children alike.
description.zh: DSH 按模型注入系统提示词：为本地已配置的模型把自定义提示词追加到系统提示词末尾，支持 provider/model 精确匹配与 provider/* 服务商级通配（两者按序叠加）。设置页自动列出每个已配置服务商及其模型，逐行编辑、即时生效；规则持久化保存、重启不丢；对主会话、subagent 与 workflow 子代理同样生效。

description.en: Token usage statistics for DeepSeek Harness: per-model daily and range charts plus a yearly contributions heatmap.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 的 Token 用量统计：近 7 天/30 天按模型的柱状图、饼图，外加近一年每日活跃热力图。

description.en: Turns a plain-browser DSH session into the WhaleHarbor lite client: a standalone browser --app window with a client-style top bar and task notifications, while the full desktop installer downloads in the background (multi-source, SHA-256 verified) and an install prompt appears when ready.
description.zh: 把浏览器里的 DSH 会话变成鲸港简版客户端：独立 --app 窗口、客户端顶栏与任务通知；后台多源下载完整桌面安装包（SHA-256 校验），完成后提示安装。

description.en: Provides an OAuth account page for DSH Web, currently supporting OpenAI Codex, GitHub Copilot, Anthropic, Kimi For Coding, OpenRouter, and xAI.
description.zh: 为 DSH Web 提供 OAuth 账号页面，目前支持 OpenAI Codex、GitHub Copilot、Anthropic、Kimi For Coding、OpenRouter 与 xAI。

description.en: Brings models from the Qoder app already signed in on this machine into DeepSeek Harness, with no token to configure, and shows each model rate and off-peak window on its settings card.
description.zh: 把本机已登录的 Qoder 应用中的模型接入 DeepSeek Harness，无需配置任何令牌，并在设置卡片上显示每个模型的费率与错峰窗口。

description.en: Interactive terminal UI for DeepSeek Harness: tables, Mermaid and chart rendering, side conversations, and the same Cordis plugin model as dsh Web.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 交互式终端界面：表格、Mermaid 与图表渲染、旁支会话，以及与 dsh Web 相同的 Cordis 插件模型。

description.en: COM-driven real Microsoft Office automation for DeepSeek Harness: drives a running Excel/Word instance through OfficeMCP — VBA macros, pivot tables, live formula recalculation, and deep document layout; plus an accounting suite (double-entry journal posting with debit/credit balance check, and SUMIF general ledger).
description.zh: COM 驱动真实 Microsoft Office 实例的 DeepSeek Harness 插件：经 OfficeMCP 操作运行中的 Excel/Word——VBA 宏、透视表、活公式重算、文档深度排版；含会计场景（复式记账分录 + 借贷平衡校验、SUMIF 科目总账）。

description.en: Dual knowledge-graph RAG for Markdown notes with half-life memory decay: prerequisite + similarity graphs (P/S-Agent traversal), paragraph chunking, n-gram/embedding hybrid search, and an explicit weight-feedback loop — a native Cordis plugin, npm-installable as @eqman00003/knowlp-rag.
description.zh: Markdown 笔记的双知识图谱 RAG，带半衰期记忆衰减：前置依赖 + 相似关联双图（P/S-Agent 遍历）、段落级匹配、ngram/embedding 混合检索、显式权重反馈闭环——原生 Cordis 插件，npm 包 @eqman00003/knowlp-rag。

description.en: Standalone mobile surface for dsh: scan-to-pair device trust, realtime SSE sync, three-channel completion notifications (in-app / Web Push / Server酱·Bark·Telegram), offline outbox, approval & question panels, per-provider usage meters, PWA; a native narrow-screen phone UI.
description.zh: dsh 的独立手机端界面：扫码配对设备信任、实时 SSE 同步、三通道完成通知（应用内 / Web Push / Server酱·Bark·Telegram）、离线发件箱、审批与提问面板、多提供方用量卡、PWA；从零为窄屏设计的原生手机 UI。

description.en: Theme skin plugin for DeepSeek Harness — built-in themes / static image / dynamic 360°-follow video, one-click from the sidebar & Settings; imports persist, default skins protected.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 主题皮肤插件：内置主题 / 静态图片 / 动态视频（鼠标环绕跟随帧），侧边栏一键切换，设置页完整管理；导入持久化、默认皮肤不可删。

description.en: Installs a dedicated AI novel-writing preset and workbench: revisioned local project assets, a compact side drawer, and native approval-gated single-file changes.
description.zh: 安装专用 AI 小说创作预设与工作台：提供带修订号的本地项目资产、紧凑侧边工作台，以及需要原生审批的逐文件变更。

description.en: Local IMAP invoice download, OCR, archive, and Excel reimbursement summaries for DeepSeek Harness.
description.zh: 面向 DeepSeek Harness 的本地 IMAP 发票下载、OCR 识别、归档与 Excel 报销汇总。

description.en: Cache-stable progressive tool discovery: a fixed tool_search and tool_dispatch surface on every request, in-memory catalog search, nested dispatch through the Harness pipeline, and a byte-stable native tool list across discovery.
description.zh: 缓存稳定的渐进式工具发现：每次请求使用固定的 tool_search 与 tool_dispatch 工具面，从内存目录搜索后经 Harness 管线分发，发现过程中原生工具列表保持字节稳定。

description.en: Runs the agent's shell and file tools in disposable Podman containers, so its access is constrained to the workspace project by default, and adds container, image, volume and secret management with approval-gated control.
description.zh: 让 agent 的 shell 与文件工具在一次性 Podman 容器中运行，默认只能访问工作区项目；同时提供容器、镜像、卷与机密管理，部分操作需审批。

description.en: Real-time usage, cost and balance meter for DeepSeek Harness: official-API balance, cost accuracy within ¥0.02, per-turn / per-session / per-model cost ledger, live color-tiered token speed and a docked one-click popup.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 实时用量、费用与余额计量：官方 API 实时查询余额、计费误差 0.02 元内，分本轮/本次会话/整个模型三级费用台账，实时分色档位 Token 速度，输入框旁弹窗即点即看。

description.en: Forces context compression when running low-context llama.cpp models such as Qwen3.8-27B, improving model efficiency and usage smoothness, together with well-refined compaction prompts.
description.zh: llama-cpp qwen3.8-27b 低上下文时，强制上下文压缩插件，提示模型使用效率和使用流畅度，外加完善的压缩提示。

description.en: Plays a short synthesized ding in the browser tab the moment an agent finishes a turn, built entirely with the Web Audio API; no backend audio and no OS notification.
description.zh: agent 回合结束时在浏览器标签页里播放一声合成的叮,纯前端 Web Audio 发音,不经过后端、不弹系统通知。

description.en: Read-only Git and SVN code review using the current DSH agent model, with change previews, explicit context and approval-gated model requests.
description.zh: 复用当前 DSH Agent 模型只读审查 Git 与 SVN 变更，支持变更预览、显式上下文及经审批的模型请求。

description.en: Read-only Git and SVN change review inside DeepSeek Harness, with repository browsing and side-by-side diffs.
description.zh: 在 DeepSeek Harness 内只读审阅 Git 与 SVN 变更，支持仓库浏览和并排差异对比。

description.en: Adds a "用量" section to the DSH Settings page that shows your MiniMax Token Plan usage (5h and weekly windows with reset countdowns), per-model breakdown, and video bonus credits; fetches `/v1/token_plan/remains` via a trusted plugin that holds the API key, auto-hides when no key is configured. MIT.
description.zh: 在 DSH 设置页「用量」section 展示 MiniMax Token Plan 的 5 小时 / 周窗口用量（带重置倒计时）、单模型明细与视频赠送额度；通过 trusted plugin 调 `/v1/token_plan/remains` 拿 key，未配置 key 时整段 section 自动隐藏。MIT。

description.en: Continuous voice conversations for DSH with hands-free listening, push-to-talk, speech recognition, TTS replies, and background Agent delegation.
description.zh: 为 DSH 提供持续语音对话，支持免提监听、按住说话、语音识别、TTS 语音回复和后台 Agent 任务委派。

description.en: Workspace-isolated durable memory for DSH, with searchable, auditable, correctable, and removable workspace memories plus controlled global memory.
description.zh: 为 DSH 提供工作区隔离的持久化记忆，让每个工作区拥有可检索、可审计、可纠错和可删除的独立记忆，并支持受控的全局记忆。

description.en: Multi-backend web_search provider (Exa + Firecrawl) for the built-in web_search tool, with automatic failover, per-backend 429 cooldowns, and key-free anonymous access.
description.zh: 面向内置 web_search 工具的多后端搜索提供方（Exa + Firecrawl）：自动故障切换、按后端 429 冷却、无密钥匿名可用。

description.en: Hierarchical Claude Code-style memory: user + project scopes (project memories committed to git for the team), MEMORY.md index auto-injected at session start, context-window guards, pure files.
description.zh: 分层 Claude Code 式记忆：用户级+项目级双作用域（项目记忆随 git 团队共享），MEMORY.md 索引会话启动自动注入，上下文护栏，纯文件零依赖。

description.en: AI Quota & Usage Monitor for DSH: real-time balance and reset countdown tracking for Codex, Cursor, Google Antigravity, and OpenCode-Go.
description.zh: DSH 的 AI 额度与用量监控：实时追踪 Codex、Cursor、Google Antigravity 与 OpenCode-Go 剩余额度与重置倒计时。

description.en: Auto-resumes interrupted DSH turns: sends a queued 「继续」 after turn/end with error, interrupted or max-tokens reasons, with a grace period, cooldown, exponential backoff, a consecutive-attempts cap, boot-time scanning, a settings card and a per-session stop/restore button in the composer toolbar; it never switches models or providers.
description.zh: 回合中断自动续跑：turn/end 因 error / interrupted / max-tokens 结束时自动发送「继续」，支持宽限期、冷却、指数退避、连续次数上限、启动扫描、设置卡片，以及输入框工具行的会话级停止/恢复按钮；不切换模型/provider。

description.en: Prompt library above the DSH composer — a 📚 button expands a searchable panel to insert saved prompts into the draft with one click (appends, never overwrites), persisted in a host-side JSON file.
description.zh: 输入框上方的提示词库：📚 按钮展开可搜索面板，点条目一键填入草稿（追加不覆盖）；数据以 JSON 文件保存在 Host 侧。

description.en: Persistent image or MP4 wallpaper for the DSH Web profile: a wallpaper card under Settings -> General selects a local image or MP4 (up to 300 MB), tunes surface opacity and blur, compresses video locally to H.264 when ffmpeg/ffprobe are on PATH, stores media under ~/.dsh/wallpapers, and pins the Web server to port 9191 so the saved wallpaper survives restarts.
description.zh: DSH Web 持久化背景图/视频插件：在 设置 -> 通用 中提供壁纸卡片，可选本地图片或 MP4（最大 300 MB），调节表层透明度与模糊；检测到 ffmpeg/ffprobe 时在本机把视频压缩为 H.264；媒体保存到 ~/.dsh/wallpapers；并将 Web 服务固定到 9191 端口以便重启后恢复壁纸。

description.en: Reverse tunnel for the DSH Web GUI: exposes a `dsh --profile web` deployment at a public frp URL and switches the directory picker to the in-app browser, so a phone or remote machine can open and manage the workspace.
description.zh: DSH Web GUI 反向隧道：通过 frp 把 `dsh --profile web` 发布到公网地址，目录选择器改用应用内浏览器，手机或远程机器可直接打开并管理工作区。

description.en: Local token usage and cost dashboard for DeepSeek Harness: four-segment token breakdown (miss/cache-hit/cache-write/output), cache savings estimate against the miss/hit price gap, per-session drill-down with context-growth curves and anomaly flags, global filters with shareable URLs, monthly budget progress with month-end projection, and day/month aggregate fast-path queries (O(days)) with incremental rescan.
description.zh: DSH 本地 Token 用量与成本统计仪表盘：四段 Token 构成（未命中/缓存命中/缓存写入/输出）、按未命中与命中的价差估算缓存省钱、会话下钻（上下文增长曲线与异常激增标记）、全局筛选可分享 URL、月度预算环形进度与月底外推、日/月聚合快路径查询（O(天数)）+ 增量扫描。

description.en: White-box AGI architecture exploration: metacognition (self-cognition loop), continual learning (knowledge flywheel), world model (condition space, spatiotemporal memory graph), self-improvement (bootstrap discipline), zero-LLM white-box pipeline, and auditable trust guardrails.
description.zh: 白箱AGI架构探索：元认知（自我认知循环）、持续学习（知识飞轮）、世界模型（条件空间+语义时空图）、自我改进（自举纪律）、零LLM白箱管线与可审计信任护栏。

description.en: Self-hosted DSH Web operations panel for safe restart and upgrade, health diagnostics, model-usage statistics and provider quota lookup, backup and session management, task notifications, skill controls, subagent model routing, and Linux permission maintenance.
description.zh: 面向自托管 DSH Web 的运维面板：安全重启与升级、健康诊断、模型用量统计与供应商额度查询、备份和会话管理、任务通知、技能控制、子代理模型路由与 Linux 权限维护。

description.en: Block-addressed document editing: an MCP server exposing geml_get / geml_set / geml_check and friends, so an agent reads or rewrites one addressed block of a Markdown or GEML document instead of the whole file. Ships the GEML authoring skill and a code-graph skill that builds and navigates a project call graph as GEML codemaps.
description.zh: 按块寻址的文档读写：MCP server 提供 geml_get / geml_set / geml_check 等工具，Agent 只取回或改写 Markdown、GEML 文档中的某一个块，而不是整篇文件。另带 GEML 写作技能，以及把项目调用图构建为 GEML codemap 并浏览的代码图谱技能。

description.en: Paper reading workbench: library + PDF reader + tutor-style companion. Answers cite clickable page numbers that jump back and flash the exact passage; select-to-ask without leaving the paper; bundled strict-tutor preset (reading plan, section coaching, graded quizzes tracked across sessions). With MinerU configured (self-hosted, no signup / mineru.net cloud token): scanned PDFs become readable, formulas become click-citable (one click sends the LaTeX source into the chat) and searchable (QK^T hits directly), plus a per-page formula panel; optional embeddings endpoint adds semantic recall for plain-language questions. Rename/delete topics and papers — deletes go to a recoverable .trash with a batch-clear flow for non-empty topics; reader with scroll/single-page modes, rightbar-fullscreen safe, one-click path copy and translated-PDF export; in-place original ↔ Chinese toggle (babeldoc, zero preinstall). Transcription and search run locally by default — documents never leave your machine; only when cloud MinerU, an embeddings endpoint, or a translation endpoint is enabled does the corresponding text go to the service you configure.
description.zh: 论文伴读工作台：文献库 + PDF 阅读器 + 教练式伴读。回答必带页码，点页码跳回 PDF 并高亮闪烁对应原文；选中即问不打断阅读；自带「严格师傅」preset——定阅读计划、逐节带读、出题批改，成绩跨会话累积；配置 MinerU（本地自建免注册 / mineru.net 云端 token 二选一）后：扫描版 PDF 可读可伴读、公式可点引用（点一下即得 LaTeX 源码进对话）、公式可检索（QK^T 直接命中），∑ 面板按页浏览全文公式；可选嵌入端点语义召回，大白话提问命中术语段落。文献库专题/论文改名删除——删除走 .trash 回收站可恢复、非空专题批量清空一次确认；阅读器滚动 ↔ 单页翻页双模式、右栏全屏可用、PDF 路径一键复制、译文 PDF 一键导出；原文 ↔ 纯中文原地切换（babeldoc 零预装）。默认本地转录检索，文档不出本机；仅当启用云端 MinerU、嵌入端点或翻译端点时，对应文本才会发往你配置的服务。

description.en: Host-neutral durable DAG workflows for Agents with CLI, MCP, on-demand Skills, triggers, replay, and a visual Canvas.
description.zh: 面向 Agent 的 Host-neutral 持久化 DAG 工作流，提供 CLI、MCP、按需 Skill、Trigger、重放和可视化 Canvas。

description.en: Bing-backed web search provider for the built-in web_search tool: prefers Bing's RSS feed with the public cn.bing.com HTML page as fallback, no API key, reachable from mainland China, and keeps searches off the model's own search quota. Endpoint, result count and result language configurable; targets DSH 0.2.x (also works on 0.1.7+).
description.zh: 为内置 web_search 工具提供 Bing 搜索源：优先解析 Bing 的 RSS 输出，以 cn.bing.com 公开 HTML 结果页作为兜底，无需 API Key，国内可直连，搜索不再消耗模型自带的搜索额度。端点、结果数量与结果语言可配置；适配 DSH 0.2.x（0.1.7+ 亦可用）。

description.en: Connect a sub2api gateway to DeepSeek Harness: OpenAI-compatible multi-provider routes (OpenAI / Claude / Grok / Gemini) behind one base URL, with per-key model discovery, usage lookup, and global vision/image tools.
description.zh: 将 sub2api 网关接入 DeepSeek Harness：用一个 base URL 统一管理 OpenAI / Claude / Grok / Gemini 等多供应商路由，支持按 key 发现模型、用量查询与全局视觉/图像生成工具。

description.en: Preset engineering workflows for DeepSeek Harness: a dev_task tool that gates stage transitions, artifacts, verification, review and commit scope, plus a web workbench for installing project or user skills and rules.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供预设工程流程：dev_task 工具把阶段流转、产物、验证、审核与提交范围做成硬门禁，并带一个安装项目级与个人级技能和规则的工作台。

description.en: Fail-closed runtime tool-call loop guard for DeepSeek Harness.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供故障关闭式运行时工具调用循环防护。

description.en: ClineBot and ClinePass integration for DeepSeek Harness: dedicated settings page, live quota dashboard, in-UI key saving, curated and custom model selection, and a /cline command.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 的 ClineBot/ClinePass 集成：专属设置页、实时配额仪表板、界面内密钥保存、精选与自定义模型选择，以及 /cline 命令。

description.en: AST-based context compression, test log filtering, and token budget guard for DeepSeek Harness: strips redundant syntax, prunes noisy log lines, and enforces a token ceiling so the context window never overflows.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 的 AST 上下文压缩、测试日志过滤与 Token 预算守卫：剔除冗余语法、精简日志噪声，并强制执行 Token 上限以防止上下文窗口溢出。

description.en: Scheduled cron tasks, background automation and agent execution for DeepSeek Harness.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供定时任务、后台自动化与 Agent 执行。

description.en: Gitea and Forgejo integration for DeepSeek Harness with issue, pull-request and worktree tools plus a Git status chip.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 集成 Gitea 与 Forgejo，提供 issue、拉取请求和 worktree 工具及 Git 状态芯片。

description.en: Goal mode and autonomous execution plugin for DeepSeek Harness: a sticky top banner keeps the current goal visible across turns while the agent works toward it autonomously.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 的目标模式与自主执行插件：顶部吸附横幅在每轮对话中保持当前目标可见，同时 Agent 自主推进完成目标。

description.en: Adds an x_search tool for X/Twitter search to DeepSeek Harness, authenticated through a separate SuperGrok OAuth account so it does not consume the session provider quota.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 增加用于 X/Twitter 搜索的 x_search 工具，通过独立的 SuperGrok OAuth 账号鉴权，不占用会话所用提供方的配额。

description.en: Adds a generate_image tool backed by the FAL queue, any OpenAI-compatible images API, or a ChatGPT/Grok subscription, and shows the result inline in the conversation.
description.zh: 提供 generate_image 工具，可接入 FAL 队列、任意 OpenAI 兼容图像 API 或 ChatGPT/Grok 订阅，并在对话中内联显示结果。

description.en: Collects and redacts DSH runtime diagnostics before filing structured issues in GitHub or Gitea.
description.zh: 收集并脱敏 DSH 运行诊断信息，然后向 GitHub 或 Gitea 提交结构化问题报告。

description.en: Visual Kanban board for DeepSeek Harness with Gitea-backed tasks, workflow columns and a dedicated agent session per task.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供可视化看板，支持 Gitea 任务、工作流列和每任务独立 Agent 会话。

description.en: Shows API-key and subscription quota limits in the DSH provider interface and settings.
description.zh: 在 DSH 界面与设置中显示 API Key 和订阅账户的额度限制。

description.en: Keeps a pool of API keys per provider with auto-created clone routes, switches to the next key on quota or rate-limit errors, probes cooled keys for recovery, and exposes the pools, cooldown and switch codes in a Settings section.
description.zh: 为每个提供方维护 API Key 池并自动创建克隆路由，在配额或限流错误时切换到下一个 Key，主动探测冷却中的 Key 以便恢复，并在设置中提供 Key 池、冷却时间与切换状态码的编辑界面。

description.en: LAN and reverse-proxy access to the DeepSeek Harness web UI: returns the settings service on pages that are not localhost, fills in the web APIs a browser withholds over plain HTTP, and can open a listener of its own.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 网页 UI 提供局域网与反向代理访问：在非 localhost 页面返回设置服务，补齐浏览器在纯 HTTP 下限制的 Web API，并可自行开启监听端口。

description.en: Renders HTML, React (JSX/TSX), Vue, SVG, Mermaid and Markdown written by the agent in an isolated iframe sandbox with SSE hot-reload, and adds a DOM click inspector, side-by-side visual diff, a responsive device matrix and one-click Vite ZIP export.
description.zh: 在隔离的 iframe 沙箱中实时渲染 Agent 生成的 HTML、React (JSX/TSX)、Vue、SVG、Mermaid 和 Markdown，支持 SSE 热重载，并提供 DOM 点击检查器、并排视觉对比、响应式设备矩阵和一键 Vite ZIP 导出。

description.en: Telegram bridge for DeepSeek Harness: bidirectional sessions, conversation steering, home-channel routing, and TTS voice notes sent as Telegram audio messages.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 的 Telegram 桥接：双向会话、对话引导、主频道路由，以及以 Telegram 语音消息发送的 TTS 语音笔记。

description.en: Mixture-of-Agents plugin for DeepSeek Harness: a /moa slash command fans a prompt out to multiple models in parallel, merges their responses in a file workspace, and integrates with Live Canvas for visual output.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 的混合智能体（MoA）插件：/moa 斜杠命令将提示词并发分发给多个模型，在文件工作区合并响应，并与 Live Canvas 集成以呈现可视化输出。

description.en: Synchronizes the model catalog of API-key providers from the provider itself instead of maintaining the model list by hand.
description.zh: 自动从服务商同步 API Key 提供方的模型列表，无需手动维护。

description.en: SSH/SFTP remote workspaces with conflict-aware mirror sync, port forwarding, and a native Web UI.
description.zh: 支持冲突感知镜像同步、端口转发和原生 Web UI 的 SSH/SFTP 远程工作区。

description.en: Adds Russian as a native option in Settings - General - Language for DeepSeek Harness, covering both the core UI and companion plugins. Localized Markdown export, in-message translation, live typography, slash-command aliases and an Alt+L layout fix, plus a settings card, all applied through a runtime locale snapshot rather than by modifying core files.
description.zh: 给 DeepSeek Harness 的「设置 - 通用 - 语言」加入俄语，覆盖核心界面与生态插件的词条。提供会话 Markdown 导出、消息内嵌翻译、实时排版、斜杠命令别名与 Alt+L 布局更正，以及一张设置卡片，全部通过运行时 locale 快照实现，不修改核心文件。

description.en: Session management for the DSH sidebar: pin conversations, search their contents, read archived transcripts and hide noise.
description.zh: DSH 侧边栏会话管理：固定对话、搜索内容、读取归档记录并隐藏噪音。

description.en: Background security auditor for DeepSeek Harness: scans agent outputs for secret leakage, checks command safety before execution, and surfaces findings in a persistent audit log.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 的后台安全审计器：扫描 Agent 输出中的秘密泄漏，在执行前检查命令安全性，并将发现记录到持久化审计日志中。

description.en: Registers ChatGPT Codex, Claude, Grok and Antigravity subscriptions as DeepSeek Harness LLM providers through OAuth, so no API key is needed for them.
description.zh: 通过 OAuth 将 ChatGPT Codex、Claude、Grok 与 Antigravity 订阅注册为 DeepSeek Harness 的 LLM 提供方，无需为其配置 API Key。

description.en: Smart checkpoints, workspace safety guards and instant rollback for DeepSeek Harness.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供智能检查点、工作区安全防护和即时回滚。

description.en: Speaks agent replies in the DeepSeek Harness web UI through a provider fallback chain (OpenAI, ElevenLabs, Google, Azure, Groq, Deepgram, OpenRouter, Edge, Piper, eSpeak), so a failing or rate-limited provider falls through to the next instead of going silent.
description.zh: 在 DeepSeek Harness 网页 UI 中朗读智能体回复，采用服务商回退链（OpenAI、ElevenLabs、Google、Azure、Groq、Deepgram、OpenRouter、Edge、Piper、eSpeak），某个服务商失败或被限流时自动切换到下一个，而不是直接静音。

description.en: Normalizes malformed token-usage samples so broken session histories remain loadable.
description.zh: 规范化异常的 Token 用量样本，使损坏的会话历史仍可加载。

description.en: Routes images to a vision model of your choice - auto-rewrite, explicit tools, or hybrid - so a text-only chat model does not fail a turn that contains a picture.
description.zh: 将图片交给所选的视觉模型处理（自动改写、显式工具或混合模式），使纯文本聊天模型也能处理包含图片的对话。

description.en: Voice input for the web UI: dictation chunked by pauses and voice messages, each with its own provider fallback chain (Deepgram, Groq, HuggingFace, local whisper.cpp, or an OpenAI-compatible endpoint).
description.zh: Web UI 语音输入：按停顿分段的听写与语音消息，各自拥有独立的服务商回退链（Deepgram、Groq、HuggingFace、本地 whisper.cpp 或 OpenAI 兼容接口）。

description.en: Stop a running background job from the session-header job list, with a confirmation dialog that restates the full command.
description.zh: 在会话头部的后台任务列表里停止正在运行的任务，确认弹窗会再次显示完整命令。

description.en: Read-only insight panel for one profile: five views over the same data — config layers, plugin tree, services, tool names and models — each entry showing which layer inserted or disabled it and whether it is running.
description.zh: 只读的 profile 洞察面板：同一份数据的五个视图——配置层、插件树、服务、工具名、模型，每一条都给出被哪一层插入或禁用、此刻在不在跑。

description.en: Durable multi-agent collaboration for DeepSeek Harness with channels, threads, tasks, and resumable agent sessions.
description.zh: 面向 DeepSeek Harness 的持久化多 Agent 协作插件，提供频道、话题、任务与可恢复的 Agent 会话。

description.en: Floating ZenTao work center: a right-edge sidebar listing tasks, bugs and stories assigned to you, with drag-to-chat, original links and auto-refresh.
description.zh: 悬浮禅道工作台：右侧边栏展示指派给你的任务、Bug 与需求，支持拖拽到聊天、原始链接与自动刷新。

description.en: OMC-style multi-agent orchestration for DeepSeek Harness: 29 omd-* skills and 12 /omd-* slash commands over the plan-execute-review-verify pipeline and team/autopilot/ralph modes.
description.zh: OMC 风格的多智能体编排层：29 个 omd-* skill + 12 条 /omd-* 命令，覆盖 plan-execute-review-verify 流水线与 team/autopilot/ralph 等模式。

description.en: Recall previously sent messages in the input box with Up/Down, and archive a workspace session from its right-click menu.
description.zh: 在输入框内按 ↑/↓ 回填历史消息，并支持右键归档（隐藏）工作区会话。

description.en: Codex Pets-style floating pixel pet with 10 built-in Petdex-compatible pets, a 9-state agent-status engine (idle/running/waiting/review/failed plus client-side waving/jumping/directions), draggable overlay, pet picker/zoom settings, notification bubbles, and a `pet_say` tool for the agent to speak through the pet.
description.zh: Codex Pets 风格浮动像素桌宠：内置 10 只 Petdex 兼容宝可梦伙伴，9 状态 agent 状态机（空闲/思考/等待/审查/出错 + 客户端挥手/跳跃/方向动画），可拖拽悬浮、宠物切换与缩放设置、通知气泡，以及 agent 可用的 `pet_say` 工具。

description.en: An Aether Gazer Verdandi-inspired DSH Web UI skin with light and dark backgrounds, wedding-themed chrome, responsive character art, and themed conversation and sidebar surfaces.
description.zh: 一款以《深空之眼》薇儿丹蒂为主题的 DSH Web UI 皮肤，包含昼夜背景、誓约婚礼装饰、响应式角色立绘，以及主题化的会话区与侧边栏。

description.en: Counts completed compactions per session in a floating window and warns only after repeated compactions plus extra token spend or high context occupancy, with all three thresholds adjustable in Settings.
description.zh: 统计每段对话成功完成的压缩次数并常驻悬浮窗，只有反复压缩过、且此后又烧掉大量 token 或上下文占用过高时才提醒；三个阈值都可在设置页调整。

description.en: A Codex-style conversation navigator for the DeepSeek Harness Web GUI.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness Web GUI 提供 Codex 式对话导航与预览。

description.en: Shows the installed DeepSeek Harness version in the sidebar, checks npm and GitHub Releases for updates, and provides manual or confirmed update commands.
description.zh: 在侧边栏显示已安装的 DeepSeek Harness 版本，检查 npm 与 GitHub Releases 更新，并提供手动或确认后执行的更新命令。

description.en: Honcho memory plugin by Plastic Labs: injects the user profile, session summary and relevant conclusions at session start, uploads each turn to Honcho in the background with secrets redacted, and adds honcho_search / honcho_chat / honcho_remember tools plus a /honcho status command; configured through the ~/.honcho/config.json shared with the other Honcho integrations, against hosted honcho.dev or a self-hosted instance.
description.zh: 由 Plastic Labs 维护的 Honcho 记忆插件：会话启动时注入用户画像、会话摘要与相关结论，后台脱敏后逐轮上传对话到 Honcho，提供 honcho_search / honcho_chat / honcho_remember 工具及 /honcho 状态命令；通过与其他 Honcho 集成共用的 ~/.honcho/config.json 配置，支持托管的 honcho.dev 或自建实例。

description.en: Authorized pentest mode for DeepSeek Harness — exploration chain, assets and findings with a Web view.
description.zh: 面向 DeepSeek Harness 的授权渗透模式：以探索链路记录目标、线索、资产与漏洞，并在 Web 中可视化展示。

description.en: Claude Code-inspired Auto Memory meets Codex-inspired Session consolidation, bringing simple, transparent, and context-efficient long-term memory to DeepSeek Harness.
description.zh: 融合 Claude Code 的 Auto Memory 与 Codex 的 Session 记忆整理，为 DeepSeek Harness 提供简单、透明、上下文友好的长期记忆。

description.en: Manage global AGENTS.md in DSH Web with Markdown preview, reusable templates, version history, import/export, failed-import rollback, and revision-conflict protection.
description.zh: 在 DSH Web 中管理全局 AGENTS.md，支持 Markdown 预览、可复用模板、版本历史、导入导出、失败导入回滚与修订冲突保护。

description.en: A terminal UI (TUI) for DeepSeek Harness.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 的终端 UI（TUI）。

description.en: Local meeting transcription with microphone and system audio recording, speaker labels, and transcript export for DeepSeek Harness on Apple Silicon macOS.
description.zh: 为 Apple Silicon macOS 上的 DeepSeek Harness 提供本地会议转写、麦克风与系统音频录制、说话人标签及文本导出。

description.en: Profile-aware keyboard shortcuts for DSH Web: supports Question and Approval cards, Standard/Vim/Custom profiles, and capability-gated Session and Workspace navigation.
description.zh: 为 DSH Web 提供按 profile 管理的键盘快捷键：支持 Question 和 Approval 卡片、Standard/Vim/Custom 配置，并按能力提供 Session 与 Workspace 导航。

description.en: Configure reasoning-effort levels and sub-agent defaults for custom DSH models.
description.zh: 为 DSH 自定义模型配置思考档位和子 agent 默认思考强度。

description.en: Code-graph integration for the DSH Web GUI: a "Codegraph" card in Settings → Plugins with index status, symbol search, callers / callees / impact views, and one-click sync / index; hosts the codegraph MCP server and injects a CodeGraph usage guideline into the system prompt. Requires the codegraph CLI.
description.zh: DSH Web GUI 的 Codegraph 集成：设置 → 插件 中的「Codegraph」卡片提供索引状态、符号搜索、callers/callees/impact 查看与一键 sync/index；托管 codegraph MCP 服务器，并向 system prompt 注入 Codegraph 使用指引。需安装 codegraph CLI。

description.en: Docker container panel for the DSH Web GUI: containers (optionally including stopped), docker inspect details, logs, stats snapshots, image list and one-shot exec on the local machine or SSH hosts — read-only by default (mutations and exec are permission-gated), with a per-container terminal drawer embedded via the tty plugin.
description.zh: DSH Web GUI 的 Docker 容器面板：本机或 SSH 主机上的容器列表（可选含已停止）、docker inspect 详情、日志、stats 快照、镜像列表与一次性 exec——默认只读（启停删与 exec 均需显式开启权限），可经 tty 插件在面板底部就地打开容器终端。

description.en: Host page for kit plugin configuration in the DSH Web GUI: registers a "Plugin configuration" section in Settings — peer to the built-in General section — through the official settings.section slot and declares a settings.kit.item child slot, which dsh-plugin-kit plugins render their own config cards into. Installing it alone shows an empty page; cards appear as slot-registering kit plugins are installed.
description.zh: DSH Web GUI 中 kit 插件配置的宿主页：经官方 settings.section 扩展点在「设置」里注册一行与「通用设置」平级的「插件配置」页，并声明子 slot「settings.kit.item」，供 dsh-plugin-kit 各插件把自己的配置卡片渲染到该页。只装本包时该页显示「暂无可用配置项」，卡片随注册该 slot 的 kit 插件出现。

description.en: MCP server configuration card for the DSH Web GUI: add / edit / enable / disable MCP servers over stdio (local subprocess) or streamable-http (remote), with js: prefixed expressions for env / header values, status badges, and hot-reload on save.
description.zh: DSH Web GUI 的 MCP 服务器配置卡片：增删改查与启用/停用 MCP 服务器（stdio 本地子进程 / streamable-http 远程两种传输），env / headers 值支持 js: 前缀表达式，带状态徽标，保存即热生效。

description.en: Profile management card for the DSH Web GUI: view, create (base / web / headless templates), copy, rename and delete DSH profiles under ~/.dsh/profiles, with per-profile port configuration and a copyable launch command.
description.zh: DSH Web GUI 的 Profile 管理卡片：可视化查看、创建（base / web / headless 三种模板）、复制、重命名与删除 ~/.dsh/profiles 下的 profile，支持逐 profile 端口配置并复制带 --port 的启动命令。

description.en: Daily RSS/Atom news digest for DSH: built-in channels plus a curated awesome-rsshub-routes catalog and custom feeds (validated on save), aggregated into one "今日值得读" Markdown digest each day and injected into the system prompt; Web GUI settings card and sidebar reader.
description.zh: DSH 的 RSS/新闻聚合插件：内置渠道库 + awesome-rsshub-routes 精选订阅源目录 + 自定义源（保存时真实抓取校验），每天自动汇总成「今日值得读」Markdown 并注入 systemPrompt；带 Web 设置卡片与侧边栏阅读弹窗。

description.en: Full-text global search for the DSH Web GUI: a sidebar search box that searches history sessions (via the sessionQuery index, with a per-session scan fallback) and settings panels, highlights matches, and jumps to the matching session or settings card.
description.zh: DSH Web GUI 的全局搜索插件：侧边栏全局搜索框全文搜索历史会话（走 sessionQuery 全文索引，未启用时降级为逐会话扫描）与设置面板，关键词高亮，点击直达会话或对应设置卡片。
