description.en: Single-model disable gate: hides denied models from DSH catalogs, blocks direct dispatch with an in-protocol error chunk, and exposes a settings UI for the denylist.
description.zh: 提供模型粒度的启用禁用机制：从 DSH 模型目录隐藏被禁用的模型，以协议内错误块拦截直接分发请求，并提供UI设置界面。

description.en: Model Health panel in Settings: lists every model configured in settings.yaml and batch-tests availability and latency for each.
description.zh: 设置页「模型健康」面板：列出 settings.yaml 配置的全部模型，一键批量测试可用性与延迟。

description.en: Manual model probe for DeepSeek Harness: a session-view tab where you pick provider, API type, model and route, then send one real raw HTTP request over openai-completions, openai-responses or anthropic-messages — streaming or not — and read latency, TTFT, HTTP status, token usage and a three-layer diagnosis chain (API request / model response / strict check) on one screen, with errors in plain language.
description.zh: DSH 模型健康检查：会话视图页签内按「供应商 → API 类型 → 模型 → 路由」选定目标，手动发一条真实裸 HTTP 请求（支持 openai-completions / openai-responses / anthropic-messages 三协议，流式可切），一屏看清耗时、TTFT、HTTP 状态、token 用量与三层诊断链（API 请求 / 模型响应 / 严格校验），错误全部人话化。

description.en: Fills missing model parameters from models.dev, imports models from configured providers, and writes per-field overrides for built-in models, with prices in USD or native CNY set as manual rates or a reference price times a multiplier.
description.zh: 从 models.dev 补全缺失的模型参数，从已配置供应商导入模型，并按字段覆盖内置模型；价格可按美元或原生人民币设为手动单价，或按参考价乘自定义倍率。

description.en: Reasoning-effort tier manager for custom API models plus cross-session preference memory: inline low/medium/high/max toggles inside Settings → Models, with atomic settings writes.
description.zh: 为自定义 API 模型提供推理强度分级管理与跨会话偏好记忆：在「设置 → 模型」中内联切换 low/medium/high/max，配置写入为原子操作。

description.en: DSH plugin: matches a model you declared on a custom gateway to the capability metadata it should have — context window, output cap, reasoning levels and image support — by looking the bare model name up at runtime; the plugin never writes your settings document.
description.zh: DSH 插件：按模型名在运行时查一次目录，把你在自定义网关上声明的模型该有的能力元数据补上——上下文长度、输出上限、推理等级、能否看图；插件自己不写你的设置文档。

description.en: Provider-tabbed model picker for the dsh web composer: left provider column and right model list, both independently scrollable, with cross-provider search.
description.zh: dsh web 输入栏模型选择面板：左侧提供商栏 + 右侧模型列表，两侧独立滚动，支持跨提供商搜索。

description.en: Model pricing for the DSH settings page: ~7,250 models / 213 providers with the harness catalog overlaid, honest lowest-listed comparison, session costs priced by the actual route, cache-leak attribution, and a verified promotion feed.
description.zh: DSH 设置页中的模型价格表：约 7,250 个模型 / 213 个提供商（叠加本地路由目录），诚实的最低标价比较、按实际路由计价的会话成本、缓存泄漏归因，以及经验证的促销信息源。

description.en: Lifecycle management UI for the llm-pi-ai model provider: create, edit, delete, enable and disable providers with custom headers and AES-GCM-encrypted API keys; uninstall-safe restore of parked providers, remote model discovery with batch write, smart routing with five strategies, union/intersection composites, per-model connectivity tests, and request observability.
description.zh: llm-pi-ai 模型提供商的生命周期管理 UI：提供商的新建/编辑/删除与启停（自定义请求头、AES-GCM 加密密钥）；卸载时安全还原滞留提供商，远端模型发现与批量写入，五种策略的智能路由，并集/交集组合提供商，逐模型连通性测试与请求观测。

description.en: Measures what an llm-pi-ai endpoint really accepts — context window from its own model list, output-token limit and reasoning levels read out of its own range errors, image support from a generated test image — then reports declared values that contradict that evidence and rewrites them only after confirmation.
description.zh: 直接实测 llm-pi-ai 端点真正接受的能力——从它自己的模型列表取上下文窗口，从它自己的报错反推输出上限与推理档位，用生成的测试图验证图像支持——再报告与证据不符的声明值，确认后才改写。

description.en: Writes live provider model lists into DSH settings and shows 5h/7d plan windows or metered balance for the current session model.
description.zh: 把各提供方线上模型列表写进 DSH 设置，输入框圆环显示当前会话模型的 5 小时/7 天窗口或按量剩余余额。

description.en: Third-party model settings for DeepSeek Harness: pick a provider and a model in the composer menu, gate a model's thinking level with one switch on the official Models page card, and configure per-route request headers.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 中的第三方模型设置思考等级：在输入框菜单里选择服务商与模型，在官方模型页卡片上用一个开关控制思考等级，并可配置按路由的请求头。

description.en: Model visibility manager for DeepSeek Harness: hide or show any model in the conversation model selector from a dedicated settings page. Per-model switches, search, provider-level batch actions, reset-all. Zero intrusion - writes only its own hidden list, never the provider config; hiding a model in use never interrupts a running session.
description.zh: DSH 模型可见性管理：在独立的设置分区页里按渠道/模型隐藏或显示模型选择菜单中的条目。逐模型开关、实时搜索、渠道级批量隐藏/显示、一键恢复全部。零侵入——只写插件自己的隐藏列表，不改 Provider 配置，隐藏正在使用的模型不会中断会话。

description.en: Modellix integration for DSH: schema-driven image, video and audio generation in a split Design workspace, a live LLM model catalog, and native web search and fetch providers through one API key.
description.zh: 将 Modellix 接入 DSH：使用一个 API Key 在分栏 Design 工作区中提供基于 Schema 的图片、视频与音频生成、实时 LLM 模型目录，以及原生网页搜索与抓取 Provider。

description.en: Displays CodexRadar model capability benchmarks in a Settings page and shows the selected session model's DeepSWE score beside the composer.
description.zh: 在设置页展示 CodexRadar 模型能力评测，并在输入框旁显示当前会话所选模型的 DeepSWE 分数。

description.en: Model attribution panel for the dsh web chat — local, zero-network structural fingerprinting (template token leaks, glitch canaries, tokenizer usage-vector matching) that scores which of 29 AI vendors a session's responses most resemble, with a per-claim evidence ledger and a 12-probe active battery.
description.zh: 在 dsh 网页端挂载模型归属面板，用纯本地、零联网的结构指纹匹配（模板特殊 token 泄漏、glitch 金丝雀、tokenizer usage 向量比对）判断当前会话的回答最像 29 家 AI 厂商中的哪一家，每个结论附带可展开的证据账本，另附 12 探针主动取证电池。

description.en: Gives DSH the full 33-tool browser surface (ctx.browser seam -> a self-hosted headless moli browser over CDP: one 127.0.0.1 daemon with Bearer-token auth, request-path whitelist and WebSocket rewriting, no root/GUI/Electron needed; single-engine moli serve with auto LD_LIBRARY_PATH/FONTCONFIG_FILE injection and a persistent profile dir for logins), plus a web panel — a real page you can click, scroll and type in, operation/console/network logs with one-click cleanup, a customizable window (border color, transparency, glass, fit-to-picture with no black bars, top-inset and self-centering) and an adjustable page size (1920x1080 by default) — plus a collapsed pill that can be dragged to any spot on the screen (free position), a live view that auto-resumes when you switch back to the web tab, and a 1920px default max edge for the live frame — and two bundled skills (browser, browser-runtime) served through the plugin built-in skill provider, so the skill centre lists them as system-level by default without writing into $DSH_HOME/skills.
description.zh: 为 DSH 挂出完整的浏览器工具面（33 个 browser_* 工具）：把 ctx.browser 接缝接到自管的 moli 无头浏览器（经 127.0.0.1 单例 CDP 守护进程，带 Bearer token 鉴权、请求路径白名单与 WebSocket 地址改写，不需要 root / GUI 库 / Electron；单发动机 moli serve 直连，自动注入 LD_LIBRARY_PATH 与 FONTCONFIG_FILE，profile 目录持久化登录态）；另带一个网页面板——可直接点、滚、打字的实时页面，操作/控制台/网络日志与一键清理，窗口外观（边框色、透明度、玻璃效果）与几何（贴合画面比例去黑边、顶部留白、默认居中）可自定义，页面分辨率可调（默认 1920×1080）——收起后的胶囊可拖到任意位置（自由位置），切回「网页」自动续帧不用再点「开始」，实时画面「最大边」默认 1920——外加两份随包技能（browser、browser-runtime），由插件经 DSH 内置技能提供者提供，技能中心显示「系统内置」，默认不往 $DSH_HOME/skills 落盘。

description.en: Personal finance plugin for DSH with structured Beancount ledger tools.
description.zh: 面向 DSH 的个人记账插件，基于结构化的beancount账本工具。

description.en: Persistent background watchers that wake the agent on new messages (file inbox or command-output delta) — the harness analog of Claude Code's Monitor tool.
description.zh: 常驻后台监视器：文件收件箱（NDJSON）或命令输出增量一到就唤醒 agent，相当于 Claude Code Monitor 工具的 Harness 实现。

description.en: Per-model reasoning effort (off/minimal/low/medium/high/xhigh) for GPT, Codex, Gemini and OpenAI-compatible models. Installs a helper, not a runtime adapter: run enable-capabilities.ps1 once per profile (Windows) and restart — it declares the levels in ~/.dsh/settings.yaml, with a disable script and a backup to revert.
description.zh: 为 GPT、Codex、Gemini 与 OpenAI-compatible 模型提供按模型的推理等级（off/minimal/low/medium/high/xhigh）。装的是 helper 而不是运行时适配器：需按 profile 手动跑一次 enable-capabilities.ps1（Windows）并重启——它把等级声明写进 ~/.dsh/settings.yaml，附带还原脚本与备份。

description.en: A newspaper-style front page for a session you left running, as a Conversation View tab beside Chat and Trajectory: a per-turn timeline (duration, steps, tools, tokens, outcome), file churn counted per file, where the wall clock went and how much of it was the model rather than tools, which single turn ate the spend, failures nobody retried quoted with their failing command, and a context-pressure gauge measured against the routed model's own declared capacity. The briefing is folded from the durable session log and never generated by a model, so it costs no tokens, cannot hallucinate, and is byte-identical for the same log and clock; it appends nothing to the session and reaches no model, and it reports a pending approval without ever answering it. Pages are offered only when they have content, and the tab refreshes itself on turn settle and on a two-speed poll backed by a metadata-only tail probe.
description.zh: 把跑着的会话排成一张报纸式头版，作为 Chat 与 Trajectory 旁的 Conversation View 标签页：逐轮时间线（耗时、步数、工具、token、结果）、按文件统计的改动热度、墙钟时间去向以及其中多少是模型而非工具、哪一轮吃掉了花费、无人重试的失败（附失败命令），以及对照该路由模型自报容量的上下文压力仪表。简报由持久会话日志折算而成、从不调用模型：零 token、不会编造、同一份日志与时钟下字节一致；不向会话追加任何内容、也不触达模型，只报告待批准项而绝不代为应答。仅在某一页有内容时才提供该页；标签页在轮次结束时自刷新，并用只读日志尾部的探针做两档轮询。

description.en: Motor-design AI assistant plugin: requirement parsing → parameter identification → candidate matrix → Top10 verification. L0 is a millisecond-level broad filter (pure JS, zero solver dependency) that ranks candidates and emits the handoff payload for the L1/L2 precision tools; usable as a local agent preset and Cordis plugin. L1 (RMxprt) and L2 (Motor-CAD) are reserved in this version — the level gate fails fast above l0.
description.zh: 电机 AI 辅助设计插件：需求解析 → 参数识别 → 候选矩阵 → Top10 校验。L0 纯 JS、零求解器依赖，毫秒级广筛候选并给出交给 L1/L2 精算工具的载荷；可作为本地 agent 预设与 Cordis 插件使用。L1（RMxprt）与 L2（Motor-CAD）在本版本中仅预留接口，层级总闸设为 l0 以上会立即报错。

description.en: Imports Claude Code setup into DeepSeek Harness from a native settings screen or CLI, with dry-run previews for skills, commands, agents, hooks, permission rules, and MCP config. Codex and OpenCode remain supported as secondary origins, with collision-safe apply and post-move checks.
description.zh: 通过原生设置页或 CLI 将 Claude Code 配置迁入 DeepSeek Harness，可先预览技能、命令、代理、hooks、权限规则与 MCP 配置；Codex 和 OpenCode 作为次要来源继续支持，并提供目标冲突保护和迁移后检查。

description.en: Fine grained per tool permission rules for DSH at the tools/pre-execute gate, deny and ask lists in Claude Code rule syntax (`Bash(rm -rf:*), Read(_secrets_), mcp__server__tool`), works standalone without migrating.
description.zh: 为 DSH 补上按工具粒度的权限规则：在 tools/pre-execute 强制执行 deny/ask 清单，规则语法与 Claude Code 相同，不迁移也能单独用。

description.en: Load Wallpaper Engine .mpkg files as the DSH web background: embedded video, time-of-day switching, unified frosted blur, local wallpaper library & rotation.
description.zh: 在浏览器里直接加载 Wallpaper Engine 的 .mpkg 作为 DSH 网页背景：内嵌视频、多时段切换、统一磨砂虚化、本地壁纸库与轮换。

description.en: IM channel bridge: WeChat (ilinkai) / QQ / Feishu with proactive push — wake the channel bot from scheduled tasks and deliver AI replies to your phone.
description.zh: IM 渠道桥：微信（ilinkai）/ QQ / 飞书接入，支持主动推送——定时任务可唤醒渠道 bot 并把 AI 回复推送到手机。

description.en: Multi-candidate mode for DeepSeek Harness (test-time scaling): floating panel config, the agent auto-runs parallel candidates plus verifier selection, scoped to the current session.
description.zh: 多候选模式插件（test-time scaling）：悬浮球面板配置，模型对任务自动执行并行候选加验证选优，仅当前会话生效。

description.en: Multi-window wall for the DSH Web UI: run and monitor N conversations side-by-side in one screen, with auto-discovery, per-window controls, and an authenticated LAN gateway for phone/tablet access.
description.zh: 在 DSH Web 界面里并排运行、监控多个对话实例：多窗口墙 + 自动发现 + 单窗控制，内置带口令认证的局域网网关，手机/平板也能看。

description.en: Secondary working directories for a DSH project: the agent keeps the primary workspace as cwd and gains equal read/write/exec permissions on configured secondary directories, configurable from the session header and the new-session page.
description.zh: 为 DSH 项目提供副工作目录：agent 保持主工作区为 cwd，同时对已配置的副目录获得同等读写/执行权限，可在会话头部与新会话页配置。

description.en: Multi-model orchestrator: the main brain decomposes complex tasks and dispatches subtasks to GLM / Kimi / Qwen sub-agents by each model's strengths, with per-model token usage.
description.zh: 多模型主脑编排器：主模型将复杂任务拆解，按各模型优劣分派给 GLM / Kimi / Qwen 子代理执行，并按模型统计 token 用量。

description.en: Multi-role parallel argumentation for DeepSeek Harness: runs the real Codex and Claude CLIs in parallel, has the DSH model (Judge) write a third-party verdict back into the conversation, plus Obsidian-style single-agent direct chat and per-role model config.
description.zh: 多角色并行论证：并行调用真实 Codex 与 Claude，由 DSH 主会话模型（Judge）生成第三方汇总并回对话；另含单 Agent 直接对话与各角色模型自由配置。

description.en: Replaces the sidebar workspace region with a two-tab browser: several workspace roots stay registered side by side while conversations are filed under the real working directory of each session, with a read-only resource tree that previews files in the right sidebar. Hiding is per tab, display-only and fully reversible; a resource folder or file can be copied as a path or dragged into the composer as a native reference, and @ completion covers every registered root rather than the working directory alone.
description.zh: 把侧边栏的工作区区域换成双选项卡浏览器：多个工作区根并列登记、各自固定不变，对话按每个会话真实的工作目录归入目录树，资源是只读文件树、点击即用右侧栏预览。两个选项卡各自独立隐藏、只影响显示且完全可逆；资源文件夹或文件可复制路径，也可拖进输入框成为原生引用块；@ 补全覆盖全部已登记工作区，而不只是当前工作目录。

description.en: Agent skill and tool for querying multi-platform model account balances: DeepSeek, Doubao / Volcengine, Qwen / Alibaba Cloud, Hunyuan / Tencent Cloud, and custom HTTP endpoints. Read-only, with 60s cache.
description.zh: 多平台余额 Agent 技能与工具：查询 DeepSeek、豆包 / 火山引擎、千问 / 阿里云百炼、混元 / 腾讯云以及自定义 HTTP 接口的账户余额；只读，内置 60 秒缓存。

description.en: Music, audiobook, radio and news player for DeepSeek Harness: streams your local music folder over HTTP, reads local .txt/.epub novels aloud with AI voices, plays online QQ/Kugou/Netease music and internet radio (HLS supported), and broadcasts daily news digests — all driven from the UI or by telling the agent through the music_play model tool.
description.zh: DSH 音乐/小说播放器：在网页里听本地音乐（HTTP 流式）、用 AI 声音朗读本地小说（.txt/.epub）、播放在线 QQ/酷狗/网易云音乐与网络电台（支持 HLS 直播流）、定时播报每日新闻；可在面板操作，也可让 agent 通过 music_play 工具直接点播。

description.en: MUV engine for DeepSeek Harness: runs the regex_scripts from a character card against model output, tracks variables, renders a status bar, expands macros and LaTeX, and styles tagged code blocks such as letter, terminal, newspaper and phone. Needs dsh-muv-table installed as well, which is its companion plugin.
description.zh: MUV 引擎：执行角色卡的 regex_scripts 实时替换模型输出，追踪变量、渲染状态栏、展开宏与 LaTeX、为标签代码块（信纸／终端／报纸／手机）套样式。需同时安装伴生插件 dsh-muv-table。

description.en: MUV variable table editor for DeepSeek Harness: a tree view of the variables being tracked, a macro test panel for random, pick and roll, a dice shortcut bar and pick-cache management. Companion plugin for dsh-muv-engine.
description.zh: MUV 变量表格编辑器：树形变量面板、宏测试浮窗（random／pick／roll）、骰子快捷栏与 pick 缓存管理。dsh-muv-engine 的伴生插件。

description.en: Electronic wooden fish in the bottom-right corner of the DSH web UI, a whale-girl sprite by default: tap the head to earn merit; it knocks by itself while the model is busy; per-session merit is stored locally, and the sprite can be swapped for custom art.
description.zh: 右下角电子木鱼，默认是鲸鱼娘图包：敲头记功德，模型忙碌时自动敲；功德按会话存本机，可换自定义图源。

description.en: Plugin governance: new/updated plugins stage in a candidate area first, then hot-mount after startup — success promotes, failure auto-disables, repeated failures freeze, one-click safe mode, sidebar diagnostics panel (npm: `dsh-my-guardian`).
description.zh: 插件治理：新装/更新插件先进候选区，启动完成后热挂载——成功自动转正，失败自动禁用，连续失败冻结，一键安全模式，侧边栏诊断面板（npm: `dsh-my-guardian`）。

description.en: Browser notifications and a beep when a session turn ends, the agent asks a question or approval is pending; clicking the notification jumps to the session; remote trigger endpoint and SSE channel (npm: `dsh-my-notify`).
description.zh: 会话（本轮）结束 / agent 询问 / 等待审批时弹浏览器通知 + 滴声，点击通知跳转会话；预留远程触发接口与 SSE 实时通道（npm: `dsh-my-notify`）。

description.en: Edit the host-wide global instructions (~/.dsh/AGENTS.md) from a dedicated Customize page in Settings - every session on this machine applies them.
description.zh: 在设置页的「个性化」页编辑此主机全局指令（~/.dsh/AGENTS.md），此机器上的所有会话都会应用。

description.en: Controls user-authorized Chrome tabs from DeepSeek Harness through a local native-messaging broker, with semantic page reads, actions, screenshots, and explicit handoff.
description.zh: 通过本地原生消息 Broker，让 DeepSeek Harness 操作用户明确授权的 Chrome 标签页，支持语义化页面读取、交互、截图与显式交接。

description.en: Native per-workspace memory on the harness's own seams: facts and a bounded always-on profile on the storage-domain JSON unit, approval-gated writes with `(sessionId, seq)` citations, deterministic recall plus session-query FTS over past sessions — no external server, no custom SQLite.
description.zh: 基于 DSH 原生接缝的按工作区记忆：事实与有界常驻档案落在 storage-domain 的 JSON 单元上，写入经人工审批并带 `(sessionId, seq)` 引证，确定性召回 + session-query 全文检索历史会话——无外部服务器、无自建 SQLite。

description.en: Vertical message pointer rail on the left edge of the chat: one dash per user message, click to scroll to that message, hover for a preview bubble.
description.zh: 聊天区左侧的消息指针导轨：每条用户消息一个横条，点击滚动定位，悬停显示预览气泡。

description.en: Requirement-driven dsh plugin discovery and environment recipes: plugin_guide matches natural-language needs to a curated plugin directory with reasons and install commands; recipe installs whole setups (通知全家桶, 安全审计套装...) from bundled community bundles with ordered plans.
description.zh: 需求型插件导购与环境配方：plugin_guide 按自然语言需求语义匹配精选插件并给出理由与安装命令；recipe 一键安装整套社区配方（通知全家桶、安全审计套装等），带有序安装计划。

description.en: Keep branching from any completed answer at any depth while the main session stays untouched.
description.zh: 从任意层级的已完成回答持续创建隔离分支，主会话始终不受影响。

description.en: Route agent network requests through a local HTTP/CONNECT/SOCKS5 proxy.
description.zh: 让 agent 的网络请求走本机 HTTP/CONNECT/SOCKS5 代理。

description.en: Network and proxy doctor for DSH: checks system proxy settings, probes local proxy ports, detects TUN adapters, tests GitHub, TCP and HTTP reachability, scans hosts conflicts and prints concrete suggestions for what to change.
description.zh: DSH 的网络与代理诊断工具：检查系统代理设置、探测本地代理端口、识别 TUN 适配器、测试 GitHub/TCP/HTTP 连通性、扫描 hosts 冲突，并给出具体的修改建议。

description.en: Hosted tool server over MCP: invoice and bank-statement extraction with in-code arithmetic checks, ledger reconciliation in integer cents, PDF and table conversion, SQL dialect transpiling, and mainland-China reachability probes run from a China Mobile network vantage point.
description.zh: 托管工具服务器（MCP）：发票与银行流水提取并做代码内算术校验、按整数分对账、PDF 与表格转换、SQL 方言转写，以及从中国移动骨干网实测大陆可达性。

description.en: Authenticated LAN, Tailnet, and public HTTPS access for a DSH Host, with persistent host identity, pairing, and QR setup.
description.zh: 为 DSH Host 提供经认证的局域网、Tailnet 与公网 HTTPS 接入，支持持久主机身份、配对和二维码配置。

description.en: Visualize the DSH process network path on Windows or WSL with layered DNS/TCP/TLS/HTTP probes, detect stale proxy configuration, and apply snapshot-guarded repairs.
description.zh: 可视化 DSH 进程在 Windows 或 WSL 上的网络链路（DNS/TCP/TLS/HTTP 分层探测），检测失效的代理配置，并提供带快照回滚的安全修复。

description.en: Neumorphic DSH Web theme with light and dark palettes, ambient lighting, material shadows, grain texture, frosted-glass surfaces, and micro-interactions.
description.zh: DSH Web 轻拟物主题：提供浅色与深色配色、环境光影、材质阴影、纹理、磨砂玻璃表面与微交互。

description.en: Suggests the next user reply in an empty composer after the assistant finishes, using the session model and rolling context summaries, with Tab to accept.
description.zh: 助手完成后，沿用会话模型与滚动上下文摘要，在空输入框中建议下一条用户回复，按 Tab 接受。

description.en: NextTavern is a long-form roleplay plugin for DeepSeek Harness 0.1.7-rc.2 Web, with character-card import and creation, worldlines, worldbooks, layered long-term memory, keyword/semantic/hybrid retrieval, character agents, and card or novel export. SillyTavern character-card import is supported; v0.2.9 fixes distribution and installation.
description.zh: NextTavern 是面向 DeepSeek Harness 0.1.7-rc.2 Web 的长篇角色扮演插件，支持角色卡导入与创作、世界线、世界书、分层长期记忆、关键词／语义／混合检索、角色 Agent，以及角色卡或小说导出；支持 SillyTavern 角色卡导入，v0.2.9 修复分发与安装问题。

description.en: Personal coding assistant that schedules, follows up on and verifies local Codex or Claude Code tasks from DSH, with WeChat, WeCom and Feishu remote channels.
description.zh: 个人编码助理：在 DSH 中安排、跟进与验收本机 Codex 或 Claude Code 任务，并提供微信、企业微信与飞书远程渠道。

description.en: macOS system notifications for DeepSeek Harness: aborted, max-tokens, blocked, interrupted and error events, pending questions and approvals, and completion or subagent-end via terminal-notifier; clicking a banner opens a configured app and returning to the page auto-dismisses them.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 的 macOS 系统通知插件：任务中止、超限、阻塞、中断、出错、等待提问或批准、完成或子代理结束等事件通过 terminal-notifier 弹系统横幅；点击横幅打开指定应用，回到页面自动清空。

description.en: UI enhancement suite for DeepSeek Harness: one-click workspace open (copy path, reveal in Finder, open in an auto-discovered editor), DeepSeek-web-style user-message nav rail, session to-do marks, flat-list polish, and a hard-restart button.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 界面增强插件：工作区一键打开（复制路径、访达显示、自动发现编辑器打开）、用户消息导航条、会话待办标记、单列表增强与硬性重启按钮。

description.en: Switchable liquid-glass theme for the DSH web UI — 14 panels become frosted glass over a fluid backdrop, with material sliders and hover elasticity.
description.zh: 可切换的 DSH 网页端液态玻璃主题——14 个面板在流体背景上变成磨砂玻璃，材质参数有滑杆，悬停时玻璃与面板内容一起倾斜。

description.en: NiuLai meme desktop pet — shouts "Ma～ma～" with a synced mouth when your agent finishes; 6 skins, signature actions, action-event binding, WebAudio-synthesized animal calls, hand-drawn SVG skins bundled.
description.zh: 牛来桌宠——agent 任务完成就蹦出来喊「妈～～妈～～」（嘴型同步）；6 个皮肤、签名动作、事件绑定、WebAudio 合成叫声，内置手绘 SVG 皮肤素材。

description.en: Approval sound effects from the movie NiuLai: plays 「妈妈」 when user confirmation is requested, interrupts it and plays 「牛来！」 the moment the user approves; native Windows playback, zero external dependencies.
description.zh: 牛来确认音：请求用户确认时播放「妈妈」，批准瞬间掐断并播放「牛来！」；梗源电影《牛来》，Windows 原生播放，零外部依赖。

description.en: Switch the current DSH session's model with a natural-language sentence, on web, TUI, or IM bridges (WeChat, Feishu), without touching the panel.
description.zh: 用一句自然语言切换当前 DSH 会话模型，可在 Web、TUI 及 IM 桥接的微信、飞书等对话框中使用，无需操作面板。

description.en: Sit-and-water reminder for DeepSeek Harness, with a cat that sits in the corner of the Web GUI. A focus cycle of 30-90 minutes ends in a centered overlay plus a triple chime that gets you up to walk and drink; the later button answers with one real sourced case about prolonged sitting and one about dehydration (built-in library of 17 entries, each with publisher, date and a link to the original); stopping produces a session report with worked time, completed rounds, successful interruptions, snoozes, suggested drinks and a good/mid/bad grade. The cat can be dragged anywhere with its position remembered and loops one animation per state. The timer and the ledger live in the host half, so a page refresh never loses a cycle; it only reminds while a DSH page is open. Cycle lengths, chime volume, cat opacity and grade thresholds are configurable on the plugin settings page.
description.zh: DSH 的久坐与喝水提醒：一只猫待在 Web GUI 角落帮你盯时间。专注周期 30-90 分钟结束后居中弹窗并连响三声，喊你起来走两步、喝口水；点「再等会」给出 1 条久坐的真实案例 + 1 条缺水的真实案例（内置 17 条，均带来源媒体、发布日期和原文链接）；点「结束」输出本次工作评价：工作时长、完成轮数、成功中断次数、推迟次数、建议喝水次数与好/中/差评分。猫可以拖到任意位置并记住位置，四个状态各一段循环动画。计时与账本在宿主侧，刷新页面不丢；只在 DSH 页面开着时提醒。周期时长、提示音音量、猫的不透明度、评价阈值都能在设置页调整。

description.en: Real-time 'We need…' and 'Let me…' reasoning-trajectory keyword stats for the DeepSeek Harness web chat.
description.zh: 实时追踪 DeepSeek Harness 网页对话中模型流式推理轨迹关键词统计的 UI 面板。

description.en: Noname (Sanguosha-like game) extension workshop. AI writes skill and card extensions behind confirmation gates, static validation and block-based safe writes.
description.zh: 无名杀扩展开发工坊。AI 在确认协议、校验门禁与区块化写入的保护下编写武将技能与卡牌扩展。

description.en: Connects DSH session status, approvals and questions to a native macOS notch app; requires the native app and Focus companion.
description.zh: 将 DSH 会话状态、审批和问题同步到原生 macOS 刘海程序，需要原生程序及 Focus 同步助手。

description.en: Companion for DSH Notch that synchronizes session navigation and read state with DSH Desktop and Web.
description.zh: DSH Notch 的配套助手，同步 Desktop、Web 与 Notch 之间的会话跳转和已读状态。

description.en: Workspace-wide sticky notes on an infinite canvas: notes are plain Markdown files, created manually, captured from conversations, or distilled by the AI, and can be handed back as context; ships 12 model tools and 5 bundled skills for creating, tagging, arranging, comparing and merging notes.
description.zh: 工作区级的无限画布便签：便签以 Markdown 文件保存，可手动创建、从对话中摘录或由 AI 提炼生成，并能作为上下文提供给 AI 使用；附带 12 个模型工具与 5 个内置技能，用于创建、打标签、整理、比较与合并便签。

description.en: Local Markdown notes as governable working memory for DeepSeek Harness agents: dual-mode source/WYSIWYG editor with images, convention or reference notes auto-inject into the system prompt with sensitive values masked, plus snapshot version history, recycle bin, undoable archiving, AI reorganization, backlinks and full-text search. Compatible with DSH 0.1.7-0.2.x.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 的可治理 Agent 工作记忆层，沉淀为本地 Markdown 笔记：双模式编辑器（源码⇄富文本，支持图片），约定/资料笔记自动注入系统提示（敏感值自动脱敏），另有快照版本历史、回收站、可撤销归档、AI 整理、双链与全文搜索。兼容 DSH 0.1.7～0.2.x。

description.en: Turn the tab icon into a green/amber status light and send browser notifications when a session finishes or awaits your input, with 47 selectable notification sounds.
description.zh: 把标签页图标变成绿/琥珀状态灯，并在会话跑完或有交互待处理时发送浏览器通知，含 47 个可选音效。

description.en: Desktop and webhook alerts on macOS, Linux and Windows when an agent finishes a turn, errors, or waits for approval — zero-dependency native notifications (osascript / notify-send / PowerShell toast) plus a Slack-compatible webhook, with a configurable minimum turn duration.
description.zh: 桌面与 webhook 通知：任务完成、出错或等待审批时提醒；零依赖，走系统自带的 osascript / notify-send / PowerShell toast，并支持 Slack 兼容的 webhook，可配置最短回合时长。

description.en: DSH notification & remote-control plane: one `notify()` API across 28 outbound channels, six inbound control channels, phone approvals/questions/task control, a Native DSH Notify & Control UI, live outbound hot-apply, multi-agent routing, and zero runtime dependencies.
description.zh: DSH 通知与远程操作控制面：一个 `notify()` API 接入 28 个出站渠道，六条入站控制通道承载手机审批、提问与任务控制；提供 DSH 原生「通知与控制」UI、出站热生效、多 agent 路由，并保持零运行时依赖。

description.en: Adds Windows-native toast notifications and a system tray icon to dsh: alerts when the agent finishes, stops, or errors, with a tray menu to reopen the web page or quit the background process.
description.zh: 为 dsh 添加 Windows 原生 Toast 通知与系统托盘图标：agent 完成、停止或出错时弹通知，托盘菜单可重新打开网页或退出后台进程。

description.en: Bark push notifications to iPhone: turn completion, waiting-for-input, and approval events sent from the DSH Host.
description.zh: Bark 推送通知到 iPhone：回合完成、等待回答、等待授权等事件由 Host 端发送。

description.en: Browser system notification, sounded by the OS notification itself, when a session needs a reply or a run goes idle; no page-focus check, at most one notification per session with a newer one replacing the old, and an idle notice reports how many background tasks are still running.
description.zh: 会话出现待回复交互或一轮跑完落到空闲时弹出浏览器系统通知，提示音由系统通知自带；不判断页面是否聚焦，每个会话最多保留一条通知、新通知顶掉旧的，空闲时若还有后台任务会在正文里说明数量。

description.en: Notification reminders, message alerts and desktop notification for DSH — a desktop notifier that raises a system toast, a sound and a tab-title marker when the agent needs your input (approval, plan review, question) or a reply is finished in the background (task complete / completion alerts, notify when done); the Settings page holds the master switch, sound and volume, the per-case toggles and the zh/en notification language.
description.zh: 通知提醒 / 消息提醒 / 消息通知 / 桌面通知弹窗 / 桌面提醒 / 弹窗通知、弹窗提醒 / 任务提醒、任务完成提醒 / 后台提醒、回复完成提醒 / 审批提醒：模型需要你操作（审批、方案确认、提问）或任务、回复跑完时，弹出系统通知（可操作提醒、审批通知、完成通知）与提示音，并标记标签页标题；这是一款 DSH 通知提醒插件、DSH 提醒插件、消息通知插件，设置页可开关提醒、调音量、切换中英文通知语言。

description.en: Email reminders from your DSH agent when you're away: fires at goal completion, blockage, before asking the user a decision, and at long-task milestones via a bundled zero-dependency Node SMTP sender.
description.zh: 你不在电脑前时由 agent 邮件提醒你：goal 完成、阻塞、向你提问决策前、长任务节点时触发，自带零依赖 Node SMTP 发送器。

description.en: Browser notification plugin for DeepSeek Harness - system toasts when a task finishes, a run errors, or your input is needed (question / approval / plan review), click to open the session, per-type toggles, and no false 'done' while the main session waits on its subagents.
description.zh: DSH 浏览器通知插件 - 任务完成 / 运行出错 / 需要你回答、批准、审阅计划时弹系统级通知，点击气泡直达会话，三类通知独立开关，主会话等子代理期间不误报完成。

description.en: Windows system and custom desktop notifications for DeepSeek Harness events: task completed, failed, running, awaiting approval, and awaiting answer. Click-to-jump to the session.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness事件的Windows系统和自定义桌面通知：任务已完成、失败、正在运行、等待批准和等待答复。单击以跳转到会话。

description.en: Notion connector for DeepSeek Harness: search, read, query, create, update, and append Notion pages and databases via six agent tools, with a Web settings page — configured once with an Integration Token.
description.zh: 配置一次 Notion Integration Token，Agent 即可搜索、读取、查询、创建、更新、追加 Notion 页面与数据库内容，并提供 Web 设置页。

description.en: Connect Notion from the GUI with OAuth 2.0 + PKCE — official Notion MCP, no integration token.
description.zh: 在图形界面中以 OAuth 2.0 + PKCE 连接 Notion —— 官方 Notion MCP，无需集成令牌。

description.en: A novel-writing workbench for DeepSeek Harness: you tap thumbs-up or thumbs-down on candidate passages, and the model distils them into a short preference profile that carries into later drafting calls while the manuscript stays out of the drafting context. Adds a chapter board, per-chapter writing packs, annotation-scoped revision that rewrites only the annotated paragraph and verifies the rest byte-for-byte, a project ledger, and local pacing checks.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 的小说写作工作台：你在候选段落上点赞或点踩，模型把这批点选蒸馏成一份简短的「作者偏好档案」带进后续写稿，正文本身不进写稿上下文。另有章节看板、每章写作包、只改被批注段落并逐字核对其余段落的批注式微调、项目台账，以及不把正文送进模型的本地情节体检。

description.en: Novel-writing guardrails: 20 novel_* tools enforce fact-ledger consistency, phase and chapter gates, machine audit with deterministic metrics, and proposal-only revisions; a right-panel workbench covers reading, TTS playback, polish, proofread, continuity checks and batch drafting, and a bypass engine runs internal steps off the main conversation.
description.zh: 小说写作护栏插件：20 个 novel_* 工具以代码强制事实账本一致性、阶段与落盘门禁、确定性机审与提案制修订；右侧栏工作台提供阅读/听书/润色/校对/全书体检/批量起草，旁路引擎让内部工序不占主对话。

description.en: "Single-Core Writing" plugin for DeepSeek Harness: Thoroughly tool-streamlined and output-hardened for quantized small models, suitable for running long-novel pipelines locally with on-device models.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 的「单核写作」插件：面向量化小模型做了充分的工具瘦身与输出加固，适合在本机用本地模型跑长篇小说流水线。

description.en: Official DSH plugin for nuphus-mcp (by the nuphus-mcp maintainers): desktop and browser automation (38 tools) with PaddleOCR element perception and Chrome CDP browsing, via a persistent stdio MCP child process.
description.zh: nuphus-mcp 官方 DSH 插件（由 nuphus-mcp 维护者发布）：桌面 + 浏览器自动化（38 个工具），配 PaddleOCR 元素感知与 Chrome CDP 浏览，经常驻 stdio MCP 子进程接入。

description.en: Adds subscription OAuth and provider Plan API-key logins through Pi adapters, using a DSH-owned credential store.
description.zh: 通过 Pi 适配器接入订阅 OAuth 和厂商 Plan API Key 登录，使用独立的 DSH 凭据存储。

description.en: Distills session work into background observations and reflections to preserve context across compaction.
description.zh: 在后台将会话工作提炼为观察和反思，以便在上下文压缩后保留会话上下文。

description.en: Exports the session event stream to OpenTelemetry OTLP and Langfuse as sanitized, buffered traces and metrics, off by default.
description.zh: 将会话事件流导出为 OpenTelemetry OTLP 与 Langfuse 的脱敏、缓冲 traces 与指标，默认关闭。

description.en: Connect dsh to a local Obsidian vault: search, read, write, move, and trash notes through `obsidian_*` tools.
description.zh: 把 dsh 连接到本地 Obsidian vault：通过 `obsidian_*` 工具搜索、读取、写入、移动与回收笔记。

description.en: Ambient fullscreen status grid for DeepSeek Harness sessions with token/rate graphs, plus ntfy push and alarm notifications when a turn ends, errors, or waits for approval.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 全屏状态看板：会话状态网格与 token/速率图表一览无余，回合结束、出错或等待审批时通过 ntfy 推送与铃声提醒。

description.en: An opencode-inspired terminal UI for DeepSeek Harness that boots as a dsh profile app plugin, with a session sidebar, streaming chat, markdown tool cards, todo lists, slash-command suggestions, a telemetry footer with a context meter and inline approval prompts.
description.zh: 受 opencode 启发的 DeepSeek Harness 终端界面，以 dsh profile 应用插件形式启动，提供会话侧栏、流式聊天、markdown 工具卡片、待办列表、斜杠命令建议、带上下文用量表的遥测底栏与内联审批提示。

description.en: Local OCR using Apple Vision on macOS: text from screenshots, photos, and scans, with no install, no network and no API key.
description.zh: 在 macOS 上使用 Apple Vision 的本地 OCR：从截图、照片和扫描件中读取文字，无需安装、无需联网、无需 API 密钥。

description.en: Local OCR fallback for text-only routes: when the session model declares it cannot accept images, the attached image is cached locally and its path injected so the model can call ocr_image — PP-OCRv5 + ONNX Runtime on CPU, no API key, images never leave the machine. Silent when the model can see images.
description.zh: 纯文本路由的本地 OCR 兜底：会话模型明确声明不接受图片时，把附件的图片存入本地缓存并注入路径，模型调 ocr_image 用 PP-OCRv5 + ONNX Runtime 在纯 CPU 上离线识别，无需 API key，图片不出本机；模型能看图时静默。

description.en: Read-only Odoo tools over JSON-RPC: server info, model field introspection, and a restricted search_read limited to an allow list of models whose domain field names may not contain dots, so related-record traversal is not possible. A draft-create tool is registered only when allowWrite is enabled, and is limited to sale.order and project.task with the draft state enforced by the plugin.
description.zh: 经 JSON-RPC 的 Odoo 只读工具：服务器信息、模型字段自省，以及受限的 search_read——仅限白名单模型，且 domain 字段名不允许包含点号，因此无法沿关联关系穿透。草稿创建工具需显式开启 allowWrite 才会注册，且仅限 sale.order 与 project.task，草稿状态由插件强制。

description.en: Spec-Driven Development pipeline for Odoo: 15 tools take a request from an immutable spec through architecture to module code or live configuration, then require a persisted verdict backed by evidence from a real Odoo instance, with fail-closed gates, human-approved batches in a declared environment, Odoo's own CSV/Excel importer, and a journal that reverses the data written through the plugin.
description.zh: 面向 Odoo 的规范驱动开发流水线：15 个工具把需求从不可变规范推进到架构、再到模块代码或线上配置，最终要求一个由真实 Odoo 实例证据支撑的持久判定；闸门 fail-closed，批量操作需在声明的环境中经人工批准，复用 Odoo 自带的 CSV／Excel 导入器，并有一份可回滚本插件所写数据的日志。

description.en: Office workspace & session dashboard: a floating 6-column sprite panel visualizing workspaces, sessions, token usage and subagents, plus Agent Mail and an office log tab. Feishu/Lark views (message feed, meeting schedules, transcripts) additionally require the `@larksuite/cli` tool installed and authenticated separately.
description.zh: 办公室工作区/会话仪表盘：悬浮 6 列精灵面板，可视化工作区、会话、token 用量与子代理，并提供 Agent Mail 与办公日志页签。飞书相关视图（消息流、会议日程、妙记逐字稿）另需自行安装并授权 `@larksuite/cli`。

description.en: Renders live multi-agent session activity as a pixel-art office in a Web UI side panel - each session is an ox/horse worker typing at its desk when busy or wandering off when idle, with click-to-view work monitors and in-place approval cards.
description.zh: 把多 agent 会话的实时活动渲染成 Web UI 侧边栏里的像素风办公室--每个会话是一名牛/马员工，忙时伏案敲键盘、闲时起身摸鱼，支持点击查看工位监控、就地处理审批。

description.en: Workspace-safe Office tools for agents: create/read Word, create/read/update Excel, and create/read PowerPoint decks with PNG/JPG/GIF image placement.
description.zh: 面向 agent 的工作区安全 Office 工具集：创建/读取 Word、创建/读取/更新 Excel、创建/读取 PowerPoint，并支持 PNG/JPG/GIF 图片排版。

description.en: A web theme recreating the DeepSeek Harness homepage with a fluid background, an elastic pointer grid, animated fish, and adjustable effects.
description.zh: 复刻 DeepSeek Harness 首页视觉的 Web 主题，提供流体背景、鼠标弹性网格、动态小鱼与可调节效果。

description.en: Claude Code CLI as an LLM provider for dsh: live model list, per-session resume, approval relay, images, a memory/rewind/changes panel, and workspaces on remote SSH boxes.
description.zh: 把已登录的 Claude Code CLI 作为 dsh 的模型提供商：实时模型列表、按会话恢复、审批中转、图片、记忆/回退/变更面板，以及远程 SSH 主机上的工作区。

description.en: Web theme and file workspace plugin with global typography controls, @file mentions, a project file tree, Markdown preview, and a resizable side panel.
description.zh: DSH Web 主题与文件工作台：全局字体设置、@ 文件引用、项目文件树、Markdown 预览和可拖拽侧边面板。

description.en: Reimplements the shut-down BSide: Olivia Lin letter API on loopback so the game client keeps sending and receiving letters: every incoming letter is delivered to one persistent DSH agent session, and the reply is written back to the local letter store.
description.zh: 在回环地址上复现已关停的《BSide: Olivia Lin》信件 API，让游戏客户端照常收发信件：每封来信投进同一个持久 DSH agent 会话，回信写回本地信件库。

description.en: In-chat read-aloud for DeepSeek Harness: tap to read, pause and resume AI replies with natural Doubao TTS voices (BYOK), reading only the final answer with code, tables and diagrams filtered; local engine, plugin keeps no API key.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 对话内朗读：点一下即可朗读、暂停、继续 AI 回复，豆包 TTS 自然音色（BYOK），只读最终回答并过滤代码、表格与图形，本地引擎，插件零 Key。

description.en: Omni-modal workstation for DSH: analyze_image over an ordered multi-card VLM failover chain, a six-tool vision toolkit (zoom, colour sampling, pixel diff, OCR, element detection, inline display) sharing the same image resolver, generate_image over OpenAI/DashScope/ComfyUI protocols, multi-card async generate_video with a /build-video-tool builder, and speak/clone_voice TTS over seven providers, all driven by one auto-saving settings page.
description.zh: 面向 DSH 的全模态工作站：analyze_image 走有序多卡片 VLM 故障转移链；六个视觉工具箱工具（局部放大、色调采样、像素比对、OCR、元素检测、内联展示）共用同一套图片来源解析；generate_image 支持 OpenAI/DashScope/ComfyUI 协议；多卡片异步 generate_video 配 /build-video-tool 构建器；speak/clone_voice 语音合成覆盖七家供应商；全部由一个自动保存的设置页驱动。

description.en: Puts the DSH web UI on a phone browser over your own tailnet, with the remote channel built on Tailscale Serve. Both sides need only Tailscale: no dedicated app, no QR code, no login page, no account of its own, and no relay of your content. The desktop half runs on macOS, Windows or Linux.
description.zh: 让手机浏览器直接使用电脑上的 DSH 网页界面，远程通道建立在 Tailscale Serve 之上。两边除了 Tailscale 不用再装任何东西：没有专用 App、没有二维码、没有登录页，插件不设账号，也不中转你的内容。电脑端支持 macOS、Windows 与 Linux。

description.en: QQ channel for dsh via OneBot 11 (NapCat and friends): reverse or forward WebSocket, DM and group chats, image and voice transcription, t2i text-image cards, merged forwards, and a settings page.
description.zh: 给 dsh 加上 QQ 通道（OneBot 11，兼容 NapCat）：反向/正向 WS、私聊群聊、图片与语音转写、t2i 文字图卡片、合并转发、设置页可视化配置。

description.en: Connects DeepSeek Harness to OOMOL-managed apps and services, with progressive Connector Action discovery and execution plus an in-app panel for managing Provider connections.
description.zh: 将 DeepSeek Harness 接入由 OOMOL 管理的应用与服务，支持渐进式发现并执行 Connector Actions，并提供用于管理 Provider 连接的应用内面板。

description.en: Alibaba Open Code Review for DSH: host-model delegation with native preview/rule tools and a review skill, plus optional OCR-managed reviews.
description.zh: 将阿里 Open Code Review 接入 DSH：通过原生文件筛选、规则工具和审查技能复用当前会话模型，并提供可选的 OCR 独立审查模式。

description.en: Open DSH workspace directories in installed file managers, terminals, and supported editors from the Web UI.
description.zh: 从 DSH Web UI 使用已安装的文件管理器、终端和受支持的编辑器打开工作区目录。

description.en: Open the current registered Workspace from the Session Header or Workspace menu in a detected or configured editor, with hot re-detection and a remembered browser preference.
description.zh: 从 Session 页头或 Workspace 菜单用检测到或配置的编辑器打开当前已登记 Workspace，支持热重新检测和浏览器首选项记忆。

description.en: Free model provider plugin for DSH with 20+ models including Gemini, MiMo, GLM, etc.
description.zh: DSH free model provider plugin with 20+ models including Gemini, MiMo, GLM, etc.

description.en: OpenCode Go provider with live gateway model discovery, online models.dev capability metadata, session routing, and Web settings with subscription usage.
description.zh: OpenCode Go 模型提供方，支持网关实时模型发现、models.dev 在线能力配置、会话路由，以及含订阅用量显示的 Web 设置页。

description.en: Serves the live opencode Go model catalog from the harness's built-in opencode-go provider route.
description.zh: 让 DSH 自带的 opencode-go 供应商跟随 opencode Go 套餐的实时模型列表，opencode 上架新模型后无需改配置即可使用。

description.en: Ports all 38 opencode themes (33 TUI + 4 desktop 2.0 + system) into DeepSeek Harness: data-driven pipeline (JSON → color resolve → DSH override), per-browser persistence, monospace/proportional choice, five code fonts, and a system fallback that keeps typography only.
description.zh: 将 opencode 全部 38 款主题（33 个 TUI + 4 个桌面 2.0 + system）搬进 DeepSeek Harness：数据驱动管线（JSON → 颜色解析 → DSH 覆盖），按浏览器持久化，可选等宽/比例排印、自带五款代码字体，system 回退只保留排印。

description.en: Attaches a stable per-conversation x-opencode-session header to OpenCode / OpenCode Go provider requests, fixing 400 MissingSessionID errors and keeping session affinity and prompt-cache routing intact.
description.zh: 为 OpenCode / OpenCode Go 提供商请求自动附加每个会话稳定的 x-opencode-session 请求头，修复 400 MissingSessionID 错误，同时保持会话亲和与提示缓存路由。

description.en: Adds OpenCode Zen free models to DeepSeek Harness as one provider, backed by a managed, isolated OpenCode runtime, with a Settings page that lists each model and tests it.
description.zh: 把 OpenCode Zen 的免费模型作为一组 provider 接入 DeepSeek Harness，底层是受管、隔离的 OpenCode 运行时，并在设置页列出每个模型并可逐个检测。

description.en: DeepSeek Harness integration for OpenContext with durable cross-session memory, automatic prompt capture and recall, session summaries, structured insights, and document retrieval.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 接入 OpenContext，提供跨会话持久记忆、提示词自动捕获与召回、会话摘要、结构化洞察和文档检索。

description.en: OpenRouter provider that reads the live /models list, so new models appear without a harness release: models sorted by name with input/output prices, per-model reasoning levels, image input, reasoning_details replay, Anthropic prompt caching, and actual spend per session including subagents from OpenRouter usage.cost, shown under the Web UI composer and by /cost.
description.zh: 读取 OpenRouter 实时 /models 列表的模型提供商，新模型无需等待 harness 发版即可出现：模型按名称排序并显示输入/输出价格，按模型提供思考档位、图片输入、reasoning_details 回放、Anthropic 提示缓存，并按 OpenRouter usage.cost 统计本会话（含子代理）的实际花费，显示在 Web 输入框下方并可用 /cost 查看。

description.en: Ranks OpenRouter providers for the current DSH model by quantization, speed, cache-heavy price, context, and uptime, with one-click switching to help reduce token costs.
description.zh: 按量化、速度、缓存重度价格、上下文和可用率为当前 DSH 模型推荐 OpenRouter 供应商，并支持一键切换以帮助降低 token 成本。

description.en: Route OpenRouter requests through a configured provider list and quantization cap, injected as provider.only/order with allow_fallbacks, plus provider.quantizations.
description.zh: 配置 OpenRouter 请求使用的提供商列表与量化位数上限，注入 provider.only/order（allow_fallbacks）与 provider.quantizations 路由参数。

description.en: A dsh-better-sidebar reader for CSV/TSV/PSV files and xlsx/xlsm workbooks: a sortable, filterable table with sheet tabs. Ceilings on rows, columns and cells, plus two zip-container gates, keep an input from freezing the tab.
description.zh: dsh-better-sidebar 的表格读取视图：读取 CSV/TSV/PSV 与 xlsx/xlsm 工作簿，表头可点击排序、可按子串筛选，多工作表以标签切换。行数、列数与单元格数均有上限，另有两道 zip 容器闸门，任何输入都不会卡死标签页。

description.en: OpenViking in the DSH web GUI: a Studio panel, a per-session memory-commit status pill with its commit timeline, and a right-sidebar tab showing what the current session retrieves.
description.zh: 把本地 OpenViking 记忆服务接进 DSH 界面：左侧边栏的 Studio 面板、输入框下方的会话提交状态胶囊与提交时间线，以及右侧边栏查看当前会话检索到哪些记忆的面板。

description.en: Configuration UI for the official OpenViking memory plugin: connection and user-key setup, local connection diagnostics, a per-session memory toggle in the composer, memory isolation that keeps recall inside the current topic, and recall tuning for score threshold, injected item count, query expansion and excluded URIs.
description.zh: 官方 OpenViking 记忆插件的配置管理界面：连接与用户 Key 配置、本机连接诊断、输入栏会话级记忆开关、按主题隔离的召回范围，以及分数阈值、注入条数、查询扩写与排除 URI 的召回调优。

description.en: Brings the codebase knowledge-base capability of langchain-ai/openwiki into DSH — one-click generate/read/update of the repository Wiki, Grounded Claims (source-traced knowledge cards) and a project knowledge base built from uploaded local files, reusing the model DSH already has configured, with no second API key.
description.zh: 把 langchain-ai/openwiki 的代码库知识库能力搬进 dsh —— 一键生成 / 阅读 / 更新仓库 Wiki 与 Grounded Claims（溯源知识卡片）与项目知识库（上传本地文件），直接复用 DSH 已配置的模型，无需二次填 Key。

description.en: Novel-writing workbench for DSH with an authoring preset, outline and character management, manuscript annotations, review workflows, and a managed local Python backend.
description.zh: 面向 DSH 的小说创作工作台，提供创作预设、大纲与人物管理、正文批注、审稿流程和受管理的本地 Python 后端。

description.en: Persistent Endeavour and Challenger peer sessions for DeepSeek Harness that plan, execute sequential tasks, and verify reported results.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供常驻的 Endeavour 与 Challenger 对等会话：负责规划、按序执行任务，并核验汇报的结果。

description.en: Drive OriginLab Origin scientific plotting from AI chat via MCP: 62 tools. Modal-dialog watchdog, LabTalk safety gate, release/reconnect, fit with initial/fixed/weighted params, fine-grained plot and sheet edits, matrix tools, FigureSpec declarative YAML (diff-able and replayable), MCP Resources read-only snapshot, matplotlib-figure bridge, PowerPoint assembly with panel labels, Graph Gallery template search, EPS export, file-access whitelist, visual regression baseline, and editable OPJU delivery with deterministic readback verification.
description.zh: 通过 MCP 在 AI 对话里驱动 OriginLab Origin 科学绘图与分析：62 个工具。模态对话框看门狗、LabTalk 破坏命令门禁、释放/重连、拟合初值/固定参数/加权、细粒度图与工作表编辑、矩阵工具、FigureSpec 声明式 YAML（可 diff 可重放）、MCP Resources 只读会话快照、matplotlib 图桥接、PowerPoint 组图、Graph Gallery 模板搜索、EPS 导出、文件访问白名单、视觉基准回归，以及带确定性反读验证的可编辑 OPJU 交付。

description.en: Zero-credential Outlook automation: 13 tools that drive the local desktop Outlook client via COM — search/read mail, drafts, reply/forward, calendar, address book, rooms, free/busy — plus a sidebar new-mail badge. No Graph API registration, no SMTP passwords; anything that leaves the machine passes a three-layer human approval gate.
description.zh: 零凭据 Outlook 自动化：13 个工具通过 COM 直接驱动本地桌面 Outlook 客户端——搜信/读信/草稿/回复转发/日历/通讯录/会议室/忙闲查询——外加侧边栏新邮件角标。无需 Graph API 注册、无需 SMTP 密码；任何外发动作都过三层人工审批门。

description.en: Runtime-switchable model output styles with Claude Code outputStyles parity, plus the output.render.* presentation protocol: a /style command, per-session persistence, systemPrompt injection, six built-in styles, a web picker, and a renderer registry with per-session/per-tool rules and /export.
description.zh: 运行时切换模型输出风格（对标 Claude Code outputStyles），另加 output.render.* 呈现协议：/style 命令、按会话持久化、systemPrompt 注入、六个内置风格、Web 选择器，以及带按会话/按工具规则与 /export 的渲染器注册表。

description.en: Agent presets whose leader does no work itself: every non-management tool call is denied at the harness boundary so the task has to go to a subagent, after a one-time lookup of the available subagent models and a per-task model choice; a second preset deliberately picks the model least suited to the task.
description.zh: 让领导不亲自干活的 agent preset：非管理类工具调用在 harness 边界一律被拒，任务只能外包给子智能体，选人前先一次性摸清可选子智能体模型、再按任务逐个选型；另一个 preset 故意挑最不适合该任务的模型。

description.en: Connect multiple Overleaf projects to DSH through OverleafMCP for browsing, analysis, and Git-based file updates.
description.zh: 通过 OverleafMCP 将多个 Overleaf 项目接入 DSH，支持浏览、分析和通过 Git 写回 LaTeX 文件。

description.en: Running pace calculator: converts distance and time to min/km pace and km/h speed.
description.zh: 跑步配速计算：根据距离与时间换算配速（分/公里）与速度（公里/小时）。

description.en: Adds a refresh button to the conversation header in DeepSeek Harness, reloading the current page in one click without losing the conversation. Desktop-first, client-only, zero tokens.
description.zh: 在 DeepSeek Harness 会话头部加一个刷新按钮，一键原地重载页面且不丢会话数据。桌面端优先、纯客户端、零 token。

description.en: A conversation-view tab for DeepSeek Harness Web showing solar/lunar dates, ganzhi year/month/day, Chinese zodiac, 24 solar terms, festivals, China public holidays including make-up workdays, multi-city weather, an epoch↔date timestamp converter with a time-zone picker, and bundled offline "on this day" history from free sources without an API key.
description.zh: 会话页头的「熊猫日历」标签页：公历/农历、干支、生肖、24 节气、传统与外国节日、中国法定节假日（含调休）、多城市天气、时间戳转换（秒/毫秒 ↔ 年月日时分秒，可选时区）与内置离线的「历史上的今天」，数据免费、无需 API Key。

description.en: Orchestration-mode preset generator for DSH: a lead agent delegates to four built-in role helpers that carry only their own tools, and the web panel adds or removes custom helpers with their own tools, skills, and models, per workspace — zero changes to the harness source.
description.zh: DSH 编排模式预设生成器：主 agent 指挥，四个内置帮手各只带本行工具；Web 面板按工作区增删帮手，可给自定角色配专属工具、技能与模型——零 DSH 源码改动。

description.en: DSH Web GUI paperclip button: a 📎 button in the composer opens a file picker (drag & drop supported) and inserts file contents into the textarea.
description.zh: 在 DSH Web 输入框添加回形针按钮：点击选择文件（支持拖拽），文件内容自动插入输入框。

description.en: Overleaf-style LaTeX paper workbench: annotate any text in the rendered PDF and let a dsh agent revise the sources with compile checks and git history.
description.zh: Overleaf 式 LaTeX 论文工作台：在渲染后的 PDF 上选中任意文字批注，由 dsh agent 改写源文件、编译验证并提交 git 修订。

description.en: Turns DeepSeek Harness into a server-grade multi-tenant platform: remote access + auto HTTPS, subuser permissions & token/daily quotas, sandbox enforcement, encrypted auth & audit log.
description.zh: 让 DeepSeek Harness 变成服务器级多租户平台：远程访问 + 自动 HTTPS、子用户权限与配额、沙盒强制、加密认证与审计日志。

description.en: Cherry Studio-style paste: multi-line/indented/fenced text or code pasted into the DSH Web composer collapses into a bordered, collapsible, language-tagged card and is restored as a fenced code block on send.
description.zh: Cherry Studio 式粘贴：把多行/缩进/围栏文本或代码粘进 DSH Web 输入框时收成带边框、可折叠、带语言标签的卡片，发送时还原为围栏代码块。

description.en: Turns large text pastes into pastes/*.txt attachments with a dock above the composer and a minimal, recognisable badge in the draft.
description.zh: 大段文本粘贴自动存为 pastes/*.txt 附件,输入框上方 dock 卡片管理,草稿内只留可辨识的最小徽标。

description.en: Paste non-image files or folders into the chat composer as native @path references, or drag them in as absolute paths, instead of the images-only error.
description.zh: 将非图片文件或文件夹以原生 @path 引用粘贴进聊天输入框，或拖放插入绝对路径，替代仅支持图片的报错。

description.en: Finder clipboard paste for macOS: Cmd+C files or folders in Finder, then Ctrl+V in the DSH composer inserts their absolute paths; ordinary text paste with Cmd+V is untouched.
description.zh: macOS Finder 剪贴板粘贴：在 Finder 里 Cmd+C 复制文件或文件夹，回到 DSH 按 Ctrl+V 把绝对路径插入输入框；普通文本粘贴的 Cmd+V 不受影响。

description.en: Folds each 4-50 KB paste in the DSH composer into its own chip (expand or delete it individually), and turns a paste of 50 KB or more into a real file attachment. Declares DSH >=0.1.7-rc.2 <0.3.0-0, so it stays visible on the 0.2 release line.
description.zh: 把 DSH 输入框里每次 4–50 KB 的粘贴折叠成独立的一枚 chip（可单独展开或删除），50 KB 及以上的粘贴转成真附件。声明 DSH >=0.1.7-rc.2 <0.3.0-0，因此在 0.2 版本线上保持可见。

description.en: A lightweight, general-purpose attachment Dock for DSH: paste, drop, or choose images, PDFs, documents, archives, code, and other files, review and manage them before sending, then pass them to the Agent as local paths. It gives non-image files a consistent attachment entry point.
description.zh: 一个轻量、通用的 DSH 附件 Dock：支持粘贴、拖入或选择图片、PDF、文档、压缩包、代码等文件，发送前统一查看和管理，再以本地路径交给 Agent；解决非图片文件缺少统一附件入口的问题。

description.en: Applies structured unified diffs (git format) to the real filesystem: multi-file/hunk parsing, fuzzy hunk location with line-offset correction, all-or-nothing application with typed conflict reports, reverse-patch undo journal and dry-run - four patch_* dsh tools plus a CLI.
description.zh: 将结构化 unified diff（git 格式）应用到真实文件系统：多文件/多 hunk 解析、带行号偏移修正的模糊定位、全有或全无的应用与类型化冲突报告、反向补丁撤销日记及 dry-run——4 个 patch_* dsh 工具外加一个 CLI。

description.en: Patch-style file editing: one apply_patch tool accepting git/unified diff (default) and Codex apply_patch syntax (opt-in), applying every change all-or-nothing after a full read-only verification pass, with sandbox-aware delete and move and a dry-run mode.
description.zh: 补丁风格文件编辑：单个 apply_patch 工具，接受 git/unified diff（默认）与 Codex apply_patch 语法（可选开启），在完整只读校验后全量原子应用；删除与移动走沙箱感知路径，并提供 dry-run 模式。

description.en: DeepSeek Harness memory and knowledge hub that routes update, retrieve, and subscribe calls across compatible plugins, with an optional transactional Rust backend.
description.zh: 面向 DeepSeek Harness 的记忆与知识中台：在兼容插件之间路由 update、retrieve 和 subscribe 调用，并提供可选的事务化 Rust 后端。

description.en: Ctrl+click file paths and links in chat: paths open their folder in the OS file manager (with the file selected), links open in a new browser tab.
description.zh: 在对话中 Ctrl+点击文件路径与链接：路径在文件管理器中定位所在文件夹，链接在新标签页打开。

description.en: Pauses the agent right before it sends the next model request of a tool round while keeping the composer usable: a bare Enter or the resume button lets it continue, and text typed meanwhile is sent along as a steering message; the pause never interrupts an in-flight API call and the model does not notice it.
description.zh: 在模型完成一轮工具交互、正要发出下一次请求之前暂停，输入框保持可用：裸回车或点按钮放行，草稿有字则随本次请求一并发出作为插话；不打断任何在途 API 调用，模型上下文完整、察觉不到暂停。

description.en: Registers the remove-pdf-background-gray skill for DSH: whitens gray/off-white scan backgrounds in image-based PDFs while preserving resolution, page geometry, and anti-aliased text edges (lossless Flate write-back), via a single Python script (pypdf + Pillow + numpy).
description.zh: 注册 remove-pdf-background-gray 技能：去除扫描 PDF 的灰色/米白底色，保持分辨率、页面几何与抗锯齿文字边缘（无损 Flate 写回），核心为单文件 Python 脚本（pypdf + Pillow + numpy）。

description.en: PDF document editing plugin for precise text editing in PDF files.
description.zh: 面向 PDF 文档的编辑插件,精确编辑PDF文字

description.en: Provider-independent DSH document parsing powered by MinerU, with native background jobs, immutable results, and safe request coalescing.
description.zh: 基于 MinerU 的统一文档解析，支持自托管与官方云双 Provider、DSH 原生后台任务、不可变产物缓存与请求合并。

description.en: During Beijing working-day peak hours (default 09:00-12:00 and 14:00-18:00) it blocks official DeepSeek requests or reroutes them to a configured target provider; off-peak traffic flows to official as usual.
description.zh: 北京时间工作日高峰时段拦截发往官方 provider 的请求，默认 09:00-12:00、14:00-18:00，可切到配置的中转目标或直接阻止并提示，非高峰正常走官方。

description.en: Auto-switches the agent to ultra-compressed caveman-style output during DeepSeek peak-pricing hours (Beijing 09:00–12:00 / 14:00–18:00, price x2) and shows a status badge plus transition toasts.
description.zh: 在 DeepSeek 高峰计价时段（北京时间 09:00–12:00、14:00–18:00，价格 ×2）自动切换 caveman 超精简输出省 token，标题栏常驻状态徽章，档位切换时弹提醒。

description.en: Session header badge showing DeepSeek peak/off-peak status, per-model token prices on hover, and real session/turn costs from actual usage.
description.zh: 会话头部徽标：显示 DeepSeek 高峰/闲时状态、当前模型 token 单价，并按真实用量统计会话与每轮费用。

description.en: Header chip for the DSH web GUI that shows whether the current Beijing time is inside DeepSeek's API peak window, with a live clock and countdown to the next transition.
description.zh: DSH Web GUI 会话头部高峰指示灯，实时显示当前北京时间是否处于 DeepSeek API 高峰时段，附实时时钟与下一转折倒计时。

description.en: Peak / off-peak rate badges for the model selector (every row) and the composer tool row, judged per provider by its own time zone and schedule; the live catalog is served from the host over a fenced route.
description.zh: 为模型选择器（每一行）与 composer 工具行显示峰谷倍率，按每个 provider 自己的时区与时段规则判定；实时目录由 host 经带信任围栏的路由下发。

description.en: A pelican riding a bicycle along a seashore in the bottom-right corner: an SVG animation that reflects the agent working state (thinking/done), with a chime and an optional system notification when a reply finishes.
description.zh: 右下角鹈鹕环海骑行 SVG 动画，随代理状态在思考/完成间切换，回复完成时播放提示音并可选发送系统通知。

description.en: PTES-based penetration testing plugin with Root-Orchestrator architecture for DeepSeek Harness.
description.zh: 基于 PTES 的渗透测试插件，采用 Root-Orchestrator 架构，用于 DeepSeek Harness。

description.en: One-click health check for DeepSeek Harness: 0-100 score, plain-language issue list, and safe reversible fixes via the profile's cordis.patch.yml.
description.zh: 一键体检你的 DeepSeek Harness：0-100 健康评分、问题清单，以及写入 profile 的 cordis.patch.yml 的安全可逆一键修复。

description.en: Free-interval session reports with AI-narrated daily/weekly digests over any date range, plus every-N-days scheduled reminders with system notifications (macOS / Linux).
description.zh: 自由周期会话报告：任意日期区间的 AI 叙事日报/周报/月报，支持每隔 N 天定时提醒并弹系统通知（macOS / Linux）。

description.en: P0–P4 deterministic-first permission gate with permissive tier, learning sedimentation and approval-history UI; hard-deny credentials and protected paths, auto-allow internal read-only tools.
description.zh: P0–P4 确定性优先权限门控，含 Permissive 档位、学习沉淀与审批历史 UI；凭据/受保护路径硬拒绝，内部只读工具自动放行。

description.en: Claude Code-style declarative permission rules: ordered allow/deny/ask YAML rules matching tool names, arguments, workspace paths, and agent identity on the tools/pre-execute waterfall, with full session-log audit, dry-run mode, and hot reload.
description.zh: Claude Code 风格的声明式权限规则：按序 allow/deny/ask 的 YAML 规则，在 tools/pre-execute 瀑布上匹配工具名、参数、工作区路径与 agent 身份，带完整会话日志审计、干跑模式与热重载。

description.en: Personal center for DeepSeek Harness: cross-session usage statistics, per-model cost estimation, global custom instructions, a global font-size adjuster, a data-driven desktop pet with bitmap & vector skins, and a conversation status overview, all local and offline.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 个人中心：跨会话用量统计、按模型成本估算、全局自定义指令、外观全局字号、数据驱动的桌面宠物（位图/矢量皮肤）与会话状态概览，纯本地离线运行。

description.en: Desktop pet for the DSH Web UI with 25 transparent animations, screen wandering, click reactions and drag, plus a reproducible asset-generation pipeline.
description.zh: DSH Web UI 桌面宠物：25 个透明动画、屏幕漫游、点击反应与拖拽，附可复现的素材生成链。

description.en: Bridge dsh session status to the cc-pet desktop pet bubble: thinking, tool calls, and completion in real time. Ships on npm as `dsh-pet-bridge`.
description.zh: dsh ↔ cc-pet 桌面宠物状态桥：把会话状态（思考中 / 读取文件 / 运行命令 / 完成）实时推送到桌面宠物气泡。npm 包名 `dsh-pet-bridge`。

description.en: A fork of zhu1090093659/dsh-pet (Apache-2.0), adding per-conversation companions with whale-girl, MIKU and business blue whale skins, model-themed colors, token-rate animation, completion reminders and shared feeding and affinity.
description.zh: 基于 zhu1090093659/dsh-pet（Apache-2.0）改造，新增每个活跃会话一只桌宠，提供鲸鱼娘、MIKU 与商务小蓝鲸皮肤、模型配色、随生成速度跑动、完成待查看提醒、共享喂食与亲密度。

description.en: A draggable Live2D desktop pet for the DSH web GUI that tracks the pointer, changes motion, expression and outfit with the session phase, and opens a right-click control panel.
description.zh: DSH Web GUI 的 Live2D 桌宠：可拖动、跟随鼠标，跟着会话状态换动作、表情与装扮，右键呼出控制面板。

description.en: A Remielle(ZZZ) desktop pet for the dsh web GUI that switches animated sticker moods with the harness work state.
description.zh: 蕾米埃尔(绝区零)桌宠：随 DSH 工作状态切换动画表情。

description.en: Desktop notifications for DSH: a system toast, a per-kind chime and a tab-title marker when the agent needs you (approval, plan review, question) or a reply finishes in the background; errors, interrupts, usage limits and multi-agent workflow progress alert too. A host half adds SSE delivery, webhook push (WeCom/Feishu/DingTalk/generic), per-turn token/cache/TPS stats, plus three message-format presets (concise, detailed, custom); settings changes auto-save.
description.zh: DSH 桌面消息提醒：模型需要你操作（审批、方案确认、提问）或后台回复完成时，弹系统通知、提示音并标记标签页标题；出错、中断、用量上限与多 agent 工作流进展同样提醒。宿主半提供 SSE 投递、Webhook 推送（企业微信 / 飞书 / 钉钉 / 通用）与当轮统计（token / 缓存 / TPS），以及三档消息格式（简洁 / 详细 / 自定义）与自动保存。

description.en: Piano performance plugin: ask the agent to play a piece and it renders on a Canvas2D grand piano with real Salamander Grand samples, an immersive stage, and an interactive 88-key keyboard.
description.zh: 让 Agent 弹一曲真钢琴：Salamander Grand 真实采样音色，Canvas2D 三角钢琴与沉浸式舞台渲染，88 键可弹。

description.en: Browser operation by accessibility refs: navigate, snapshot the page as a ref tree, act on elements, and wait for conditions; the origin policy follows the session approval stance and is enforced by request interception.
description.zh: 按无障碍 ref 操控浏览器：导航、把页面快照成 ref 树、操作元素、等待条件；域名策略跟随会话审批状态，并由请求拦截层强制执行。

description.en: Keeps running, finished-but-unopened and currently open sessions pinned above the workspace groups in the DSH Web sidebar, and lets any session or workspace be pinned there from its own "..." menu.
description.zh: 把运行中、跑完未点开和当前打开的会话固定在 DSH Web 侧栏工作区分组上方，并可从任意会话/工作区的「...」菜单里全局置顶。

description.en: Pokémon-style skin for DSH Web with GBA frames, HP-bar status, effort level panel, and customizable color palettes.
description.zh: 宝可梦风格 DSH Web 皮肤，含 GBA 双边框、HP 条状态、推理等级面板与可自定义配色。

description.en: Plan-and-execute orchestration over ReactLoopAgent — turns a goal into reviewable steps with a web UI plan card.
description.zh: 基于 ReactLoopAgent 的 Plan-and-Execute 编排插件，将目标拆解为可审阅的步骤并以 Web UI 卡片呈现。

description.en: Checks each step of a plan before you approve it, using command rules plus Jev or an OpenAI-compatible endpoint with logprobs, and marks steps that can't be undone, affect things outside the workspace, weren't asked for or are too vague on the plan review card.
description.zh: 在你同意执行计划前逐步检查每一步，用命令规则加上 Jev 或支持 logprobs 的 OpenAI 兼容端点，在计划审阅卡片上标出无法恢复、影响工作区以外、需求没提到或描述太模糊的步骤。

description.en: Opens the official Plannotator app (plannotator.ai) so you can review the agent's plan — annotate, approve, or send it back.
description.zh: 打开官方 Plannotator 应用（plannotator.ai）审代理写好的计划：批注、批准，或打回重写。

description.en: Academic writing toolkit for DSH agents: paper outlines, title and abstract skeletons, GB/T 7714 / APA / MLA citations, phrasing QA, and a pre-submission checklist.
description.zh: 为 DSH agent 提供学术写作工具包：论文大纲、标题与摘要骨架、GB/T 7714 / APA / MLA 引文格式化、措辞质检与投稿前清单。

description.en: Connects DeepSeek Harness to the AdWhispr remote MCP server through mcp-remote with browser OAuth sign-in, adding tools for competitor ad research, ad creative cloning, and launching and managing Meta, Google and TikTok campaigns. Requires an AdWhispr account.
description.zh: 通过 mcp-remote 加浏览器 OAuth 登录，把 DeepSeek Harness 接到 AdWhispr 的远程 MCP 服务：竞品广告调研、广告创意克隆，以及 Meta／Google／TikTok 广告的投放与管理。需要 AdWhispr 账号。

description.en: Pool AI provider accounts per platform and route them through a local loopback proxy that bridges the OpenAI, OpenAI-Responses, Anthropic and Gemini protocols, then write the proxy into Codex, Claude Code, Gemini CLI, Grok, OpenCode, OpenClaw and Hermes config files with snapshot-and-rollback safe writes; registers no agent tools.
description.zh: 按平台把 AI 供应商账号组成算力池，经本地回环代理路由并在 OpenAI、OpenAI-Responses、Anthropic、Gemini 四种协议间桥接，再用带快照回滚的安全直写把代理写进 Codex、Claude Code、Gemini CLI、Grok、OpenCode、OpenClaw、Hermes 的配置文件；不注册任何 agent 工具。

description.en: Runs AItelier pipelines from DSH over MCP: 39 tools (22 read, 17 write) to generate, run, inspect, edit, export and import multi-step SkillFlow pipelines. The steps execute in AItelier rather than in the DSH session and are polled by run_id, pause at engine-enforced checkpoints answered with answer_checkpoint, and leave per-step traces and step outputs to read afterwards; add_provider / map_model / edit_role point an individual role at a local or cheaper endpoint. Bundles an aitelier-pipelines skill.
description.zh: 从 DSH 经 MCP 运行 AItelier 流水线：39 个工具（22 读、17 写），用于生成、运行、查看、编辑、导出与导入多步 SkillFlow 流水线。步骤在 AItelier 中执行而不占用 DSH 会话，按 run_id 轮询，在引擎强制的检查点暂停并由 answer_checkpoint 应答，事后可读取逐步 trace 与各步输出；add_provider / map_model / edit_role 可把单个角色指向本地或更便宜的端点。随包附带 aitelier-pipelines skill。

description.en: Native OS notifications for approval and question/plan prompts: the toast names the workspace, click jumps to it, bilingual (zh-CN/zh-TW/en), with chime.
description.zh: 审批与选择方案的系统级桌面通知：通知显示所属工作区、点击跳转到对应工作区，多语言（简中/繁中/英文），附提示音。

description.en: Codex Appshots for DSH: capture the frontmost active window via global shortcut and seamlessly mount it into the composer for agent queries.
description.zh: DSH 版 Codex Appshots：全局快捷键精准捕获当前工作窗口，零摩擦挂载至 Composer 作为上下文向 Agent 提问。

description.en: Settings section for archived sessions: browse by workspace, search, batch unarchive with the sidebar updating live, and optional auto-archive rules (idle days, keep-last-N per workspace) with a dry-run preview — plus a left-edge turn rail for jumping between turns of long conversations and ↑/↓ input history in the composer.
description.zh: 设置页的归档会话分区：按工作区分组浏览、搜索、批量取消归档，侧边栏实时恢复；自动归档规则（不活跃天数、每工作区保留条数）可选，执行前可试运行预览。另含长会话的左缘轮次刻度尺（悬停预览、点击跳转、Alt+↑/↓ 逐轮移动）与输入框 ↑/↓ 历史翻找。

description.en: Manage archived conversations in the Settings UI: unarchive them back to the sidebar, or permanently delete them with confirmation.
description.zh: 在设置界面管理已归档对话：一键取消归档，或经确认后永久删除。

description.en: A Wang Lin cultivation companion for dsh: watches your session state and acts it out with rich animations, and levels up as you cultivate.
description.zh: 渡劫飞升：仙逆王林修炼伙伴。实时监控会话状态，用打坐、掐诀、御剑、雷龙等丰富交互动画演绎大模型的每一个动作，随使用修炼升境。

description.en: Search-first capability workflow for DSH agents (v1.0.0): reuse local tools or review exact-source plugins before installation, adapt or create capabilities in managed source work, and use receipts that distinguish installed, loaded, activated, and verified states; version tools cover rollback, adoption, and upstream updates.
description.zh: AutoEvo v1.0.0 为 DSH Agent 提供 Search-first 能力工作流：优先复用本地工具或审查精确来源插件后再安装；可在受管源码中改造或新建能力；回执区分 installed、loaded、activated、verified，版本工具支持回滚、领养与上游更新。

description.en: A floating credit/quota widget for the DeepSeek Harness Web: shows DeepSeek / OpenCode Go balances and usage, and tracks DSH session token usage and estimated cost by day, month, and model.
description.zh: DSH Web 的 LLM 额度/用量悬浮窗：显示 DeepSeek / OpenCode Go 余额与套餐用量，并按日、月、模型统计 DSH 会话 token 用量与费用估算。

description.en: Moves an existing DSH session to another agent preset through a previewable five-section handoff, preserving the source session and either pausing the target for confirmation or continuing immediately.
description.zh: 通过可预览的五段式交接，将已有 DSH 会话迁移到另一个 Agent Preset；保留源会话，并可让目标会话暂停等待确认或立即继续。

description.en: Ranks workspaces holding a session that wants attention to the top of the sidebar session list - waiting on you first, then running, then finished-but-unopened, then just read - and draws those rows with a state bar, tinted surface and coloured title, plus a one-shot settle pulse when a run stops. Every colour is taken from the active theme's own tokens, and the three windows that decide how long a finished session stays promoted are settings.
description.zh: 把含“需要注意的会话”的工作区按紧急度排到侧栏会话列表最前——待你处理优先，其次运行中，再次完成未读，最后刚读过的——并为这些行画状态竖条、着色底与着色标题，一次运行结束时播放一次收敛动效。所有颜色都取自当前主题自身的变量；决定完成会话置顶时长的三个窗口都是可配置项。

description.en: Infinite canvas for sessions, with regions bound to workspaces and agent presets, pinned session cards, sticky notes and alignment guides.
description.zh: 无限会话画布，区域绑定工作区与智能体预设，可钉住会话卡片、放置便签，带对齐参考线。

description.en: Skills & MCP section in Settings: browse, create, edit and delete skills with live directory watching, toggle loading of any on-disk skill through frontmatter policy keys, register local folders or GitHub repos as extra skill scan roots, edit the MCP server rows in the profile patch, import MCP config from Claude Code or Codex, and install from a curated market of skill repos and MCP servers.
description.zh: 设置页的「技能与 MCP」分区：技能目录实时监听，可浏览、新建、编辑、删除技能，用 frontmatter 策略键开关任何落在磁盘上的技能；本地目录或 GitHub 仓库可注册为额外技能扫描根；profile 的 MCP 服务器行在页面上编辑，可从 Claude Code / Codex 配置导入；另带精选技能仓库与 MCP 服务器的市场。

description.en: Bring a DSH plugin repository's build and release pipeline into the app: a sidebar panel listing each repository's latest workflow run, its releases, and how far the local checkout has drifted from the last release, with buttons to trigger a build, cut a release, publish a draft, re-run, cancel, or read the failed-step log. Drives the workflows through the machine's authenticated gh CLI, so the plugin stores no credential of its own, and which repositories are tracked lives in a config file rather than the package.
description.zh: 把 DSH 插件仓库的持续构建与发布搬进应用：侧边栏面板逐仓库显示最近一次工作流运行、已发布与草稿 Release，以及本地检出相对上次发布的领先与未提交情况，并提供触发构建、发布、公开草稿、重跑、取消、查失败日志等按钮。通过本机已登录的 gh CLI 驱动工作流，插件自身不保存任何凭据，被监视的仓库列表放在配置文件里、不打进包。

description.en: Installs the coaligne-workflow skill for CoAligne team collaboration; requires CoAligne Desktop (signed in) to provide the MCP connection - not usable without Desktop.
description.zh: 安装 CoAligne 团队协作的 coaligne-workflow skill；MCP 连接由登录后的 CoAligne Desktop 提供，不安装 Desktop 则无法使用。

description.en: A CodeGraph tool scoped to the session's own indexed project, resolved from its workspace directory. One MCP server is launched through npx per project root and shared by every session working there; a project indexed mid-session is enabled without a restart, and the managed child process is reaped when the harness exits.
description.zh: 按会话自身的已索引项目提供 CodeGraph 工具，项目由 workspace 目录解析得出。每个项目根经 npx 启动一个 MCP 服务并被该项目下所有会话共享；会话中途建好索引即自动启用，无需重启；harness 退出时受管子进程被回收。

description.en: Collapses consecutive tool-use and thinking steps between messages into a single bracketed, expandable item.
description.zh: 把消息之间连续的工具调用与思考步骤折叠成单个可展开的括号条目。

description.en: Compares existing DSH sessions or runs controlled A/B trials between agent presets, showing aligned timelines, paired metric deltas, explicit success checks, and exportable reports.
description.zh: 对比已有 DSH 会话，或在两套 Agent Preset 之间运行受控 A/B 试验，展示对齐时间线、配对指标差值、显式验收结果与可导出的报告。

description.en: Browse and manage the community plugin catalog from a first-level DeepSeek Harness Settings page, with verified installs and updates, removal, pause and resume, installed-package state, and sanitized README previews.
description.zh: 在 DeepSeek Harness 设置一级页面中浏览和管理社区插件目录，支持验证后安装与更新、删除、暂停与恢复、已安装状态查看及安全 README 预览。

description.en: Preventive content policy for tool results: rewrites matched text, and drops or truncates whole fields by path before a result is normalised, rendered or persisted, so an unreviewed payload never enters it. Ships inert with no built-in category or domain blocklist.
description.zh: 工具结果的预防式内容策略：改写命中文本，并按字段路径整段丢弃或截断，让未经审查的载荷在结果被规范化/渲染/落盘之前就进不去。随包为真空操作，不含任何内置的类别或域名黑名单。

description.en: Local image, voice, music and SFX generation plus transcription, with pinned identity: characters, animals, objects and actor voices are defined once and reused on every later call, degenerate output (a near-flat image, silent audio) is rejected instead of returned as success, and a generated line can be read back as text so a clone that swallowed its ending becomes visible. The engines unload when idle, and image generation and transcription can each be pointed at an OpenAI-shaped API instead of the local Vulkan backend.
description.zh: 本地生成图像/配音/音乐/音效并听写，同一性锁定：角色、动物、道具与配音角色定妆定声一次，之后每次调用复用同一份参考；退化产物（接近纯色的图、静音的音频）被拒绝而不是当成成功返回；生成的台词可以听写回文字，好让吞掉结尾的克隆暴露出来。空闲时引擎卸载显存，生图与听写也可改指向任意 OpenAI 形状的 API 而不用本地 Vulkan 后端。

description.en: Cron scheduler for agent tasks: create jobs by natural language or a sidebar UI, inject a user message into a new or fixed session on schedule to trigger a full agent turn, with run history, manual trigger, and live SSE sync. Requires DSH session format v4 (official DeepSeek Harness 0.1.7+): injected messages declare the producer-owned source kind plugin:cron.
description.zh: Agent 任务定时调度器：自然语言或侧栏 UI 创建任务，到点向新建/固定会话注入 user 消息触发完整 agent turn，带执行历史、手动触发与 SSE 实时同步。要求 DSH session format v4（官方 DeepSeek Harness 0.1.7+）：注入消息使用 producer-owned source kind plugin:cron。

description.en: Vision MCP and DSH bundle for text-only DeepSeek: analyze_image, analyze_clipboard, compare_images and vision_status tools, a visual settings page, free GLM-4.6V-Flash by default, result caching and rate-limit tolerance; keys stay out of logs.
description.zh: 面向纯文本 DeepSeek 的视觉 MCP + DSH 插件：analyze_image / analyze_clipboard / compare_images / vision_status 四个工具、可视化配置页、默认免费 GLM-4.6V-Flash、结果缓存与限流容错，Key 不入日志。

description.en: Ship a project to Cloudflare and publish your plugin to npm — the first deploy needs no cloud account, and credentials never reach the model.
description.zh: 一句话把项目部署到 Cloudflare、把做好的插件发布到 npm：首次部署零账号，凭据模型看不到。

description.en: Offline mirror of the official DeepSeek Harness documentation as a dsh skill: 168 site pages (EN/zh) plus 52 repository-only reference docs, with topic navigation and a full-text search index for plugin development.
description.zh: 以 dsh-plugin-dev-kb 技能内置 DeepSeek Harness 官方文档离线镜像：站点中英 168 页 + 仓库补充文档 52 篇，带主题导航与全文检索，编写插件时随时查阅。

description.en: Ships a skill that documents how to build, debug and publish DSH plugins - host and client package skeleton, developing a forked plugin inside a throwaway profile, publishing to GitHub and npm, and the pitfalls found while shipping them. Installing the plugin registers the skill.
description.zh: 携带一份技能，讲怎么开发、调试、发布 DSH 插件——host/client 双半包骨架、把 fork 挂进丢弃式 profile 开发、发布到 GitHub 与 npm，以及发布过程中实际踩到的坑。安装插件即注册该技能。

description.en: Installed-plugin catalog for DSH: group plugins by origin (official vs self-installed) in a searchable panel with enable/disable, uninstall, and one-click update. Published on npm as dsh-plugin-diraud.
description.zh: 装在 DSH 里的插件目录：按来源（官方/自装）分组展示已安装插件，可搜索，支持启用/停用、卸载和一键更新。已发布 npm 包 dsh-plugin-diraud。

description.en: Discord bridge loaded into the same Host as the desktop app or dsh web, with no separate process or profile — chat with sessions in any workspace from DMs or threads, attach to sessions open on the desktop, and answer tool approvals and model questions from whichever side responds first.
description.zh: 与桌面端或 dsh web 运行在同一个 Host 里的 Discord 桥接，无需单独进程或 profile：在私信或线程里与任意工作区的会话对话，接入桌面端正在用的会话，工具审批和模型提问在 Discord 与桌面端谁先答谁生效。

description.en: DIT.ai provider bundle for DeepSeek Harness: installs 29 OpenAI Chat Completions models and 10 Anthropic Messages models from one DIT_API_KEY, with protocol-specific thinking configuration.
description.zh: DIT.ai 的 DeepSeek Harness 模型接入 bundle：使用一个 DIT_API_KEY 安装 29 个 OpenAI Chat Completions 模型和 10 个 Anthropic Messages 模型，并按协议配置 thinking。

description.en: Education toolkit for DSH agents: lesson-plan skeletons by grade band, quiz scaffolding and answer-key validation, analytic rubrics, Anki/markdown flashcards, and readability levels.
description.zh: 为 DSH agent 提供教育工具包：按学段的教案骨架、测验题与答案校验、分析式评分量规、Anki/markdown 闪卡与可读性分级。

description.en: Adds an Execution graph conversation-view tab that renders each turn's prompts, replies, and tool calls/results as a foldable timeline with a detail panel and PNG export.
description.zh: 在会话视图中新增「执行图」标签页，把每个轮次的提问、模型回复与工具调用/结果渲染为可折叠的时间轴，并带详情面板与 PNG 导出。

description.en: Floating FC/NES game hall for DSH Web with fceumm, local ROM upload, and GitHub online library.
description.zh: 在 DSH Web 右下角挂悬浮球打开 FC/NES 游戏厅（fceumm），支持本地上传与自填 GitHub 在线库。

description.en: Finance data toolkit for DSH agents: number and currency formatting (incl. Chinese wan/yi units), return and CAGR math, valuation and profitability ratios, PV/FV, risk metrics, and a data-quality checklist.
description.zh: 为 DSH agent 提供金融数据工具包：数字与货币格式化（含中文万/亿单位）、收益与年化计算、估值与盈利比率、现值/终值、风险指标与数据质量清单。

description.en: Focus board for DeepSeek Harness agents: durable, model-maintained notes in the session workspace that pin the objective, constraints, and decisions across compaction and sessions, with automatic context injection, archive on clear, and an optional web panel.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness agent 提供持久化专注板：在会话工作区维护目标、约束与决策笔记，跨压缩与会话存活，支持自动注入上下文、清空归档与可选 Web 面板。

description.en: Installation safety gate for DSH plugins: antivirus-style scan of install scripts, permissions, secrets and network callbacks on local directories or npm tarballs, returning a BLOCK/WARN/PASS verdict before "dsh plugin add".
description.zh: DSH 插件的安装安全闸门：在 "dsh plugin add" 前对本地目录或 npm 包做"杀毒"式扫描（安装脚本、权限、密钥、网络回连），给出 BLOCK/WARN/PASS 判定。

description.en: Code-first React and TypeScript task apps rendered inline, in Canvas, full screen, or on localhost, with interaction state available to later agent turns and approval-gated MCP and API access.
description.zh: Code-first React + TypeScript 任务应用，支持 Inline、Canvas、全屏与 localhost；交互状态可供 Agent 后续轮次读取，MCP 和 API 访问在用户授权后执行。

description.en: First-class Git tools for the model: status / diff / log / commit / branch with validated messages and paths - no bare-shell git calls.
description.zh: 一等公民的 Git 工具：status / diff / log / commit / branch，参数与路径校验、零 shell 调用，杜绝注入。

description.en: Gives dsh the ability to generate images and videos through the grok2api API.
description.zh: 让 dsh 通过 grok2api 的 API 获得生成图片与视频能力。

description.en: The DSH plugin-development knowledge base as an on-demand agent skill: official constraints, task workflows, API reference and community gotchas, installed with the bundle so the agent can look things up while building a plugin.
description.zh: DSH 插件开发知识库，作为按需加载的 agent 技能随 bundle 安装：官方约束、任务工作流、API 参考与社区踩坑，写插件时让 DSH 自己查。

description.en: Live dot-matrix whale wallpaper for the DSH Web UI: ~1,750 breathing WebGL2 particles with pointer liquid vortices, light/dark themes, and a Canvas2D fallback.
description.zh: DSH Web 动态点阵鲸鱼壁纸：约 1,750 个呼吸的 WebGL2 粒子，指针液态涡流交互，明暗双主题，带 Canvas2D 回退。

description.en: Interval heartbeat that wakes each root agent itself (followup injection) to proactively report progress, risks or blockers: busy-safe queuing, no stacking, auto-pauses when no human replies, re-arms on the next user message.
description.zh: 定时心跳：用 followup 注入唤醒每个根 agent 主动汇报进展、风险与卡点——忙碌时排队不打断、最多保留一条、连续无人回应自动暂停，用户下一条消息即恢复。

description.en: Claude-Code-style lifecycle hooks: configured shell commands run before/after model tool calls with a JSON payload on stdin; a non-zero pre-tool exit blocks the call.
description.zh: Claude Code 风格生命周期 hooks：工具调用前后自动执行 shell 命令（stdin 收 JSON payload），pre-tool 非零退出即阻断调用。

description.en: Image-to-text input for the Web UI: paste or drag an image and it is transcribed into structured text and sent, giving text-only LLMs image-input takeover (OpenAI-compatible vision API).
description.zh: 图片转文字输入插件：粘贴/拖拽图片自动转为结构化文字描述发送，给纯文本 LLM 提供图片输入接管（OpenAI 兼容视觉 API）。

description.en: Install tab in Settings → Plugins: install, update and remove any plugin by npm spec, `github:user/repo` or local path through the same `dsh plugin add` CLI path; update checks against npm latest or GitHub HEAD with a downgrade guard and resolved-version verification, a pnpm 11 release-cooldown bypass on every add/remove, and service restart via the DSH Desktop shell or a relay process under standalone `dsh web`.
description.zh: 设置 → 插件里的「安装」标签页：按 npm spec、`github:user/repo` 或本地路径安装、更新、卸载任意插件，走的都是 `dsh plugin add` 这条 CLI 路径；更新检查对照 npm latest 或 GitHub HEAD，带降级保护与装后版本核对，每次 add/remove 均附带 pnpm 11 发布冷静期豁免；服务重启在 DSH Desktop 由壳层执行，独立 `dsh web` 下由中转进程接力并交接回原终端。

description.en: Plugin value auditor: pre-install review (source scan + LLM judge) and post-install audit of installed bundles, with model-switch re-audit reminders.
description.zh: 插件价值裁判：装前审核（源码静态扫描 + LLM 裁判）与装后审计已装插件，模型切换时弹窗提醒复核；判断插件对当前模型是增强还是压制。

description.en: A liquid glass UI plugin for the DSH desktop app. Works alongside most wallpaper plugins. Currently supports dark mode only.
description.zh: 适用于 DSH 桌面端的液态玻璃 UI 美化插件，可与大部分壁纸插件联动使用，目前仅适配深色模式。
